66456.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片 (A) 幾乎全是中等大小、核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質少且無顆粒的母細胞；流式 (B) 母細胞 (紅色) CD34、CD19、TdT、cCD79a 陽性而 cMPO、CD10 陰性，加上核型 (C) 與 FISH (D–G) 顯示 KMT2A 與 IGH 雙重重排，故為 B 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Panel A: sheets of medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm; no Auer rods
Panel B (flow): blast population (red) CD34+, CD19+, cytoplasmic CD79a+, TdT+, with CD22 dim/partial and negative for cMPO, CD33, CD10, cytoplasmic IgM and CD20
Panel C (karyotype): arrows mark an extra X, t(8;14) and t(11;12) abnormalities
Panels D–E: IGH and KMT2A break-apart FISH each show one split red/green signal pair plus a fused signal, indicating rearrangement
Panels F–G: dual-fusion probes show fusion signals for KMT2A::TXNRD1 and SPIDR::IGH; Panel H plots marked CEBPD overexpression versus other B-ALL cases
66456.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is replaced by medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm, without Auer rods. Flow cytometry shows the blasts to express CD34, CD19, cytoplasmic CD79a and TdT, with dim CD22, and to lack myeloperoxidase, CD33, CD10, cytoplasmic IgM and CD20, a CD10-negative (pro-B) immunophenotype. Karyotype demonstrates 47,XX,+X,t(8;14)(q11;q32),t(11;12)(q23;q23), and break-apart and dual-fusion FISH confirm KMT2A and IGH rearrangements with KMT2A::TXNRD1 and SPIDR/CEBPD::IGH fusions, the latter associated with CEBPD overexpression. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with concurrent KMT2A and IGH::CEBPD rearrangements.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts are MPO cytochemistry negative but express CD13/CD33/CD117 and lack cytoplasmic CD79a and strong CD19.
T-ALL blasts are morphologically identical but express cytoplasmic CD3 and lack CD19/CD79a.
MPAL requires MPO positivity or monocytic differentiation in addition to B-lineage markers, which is absent here (cMPO negative).
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, are TdT/CD34 negative with surface light chain and MYC rearrangement.

66392.recognize_zh: 紅血球普遍變小、中央淡染區擴大（低色素小球性），夾雜許多細長的橢圓形與鉛筆狀紅血球 (pencil cells)，是缺鐵性貧血 (iron deficiency anemia) 的典型抹片表現。
features: Red cells are small with enlarged central pallor (microcytosis and hypochromia)
Numerous elliptocytes and elongated, thin pencil cells
Marked anisopoikilocytosis with scattered crenated cells (likely drying artifact) and occasional fragmented or irregular forms
Platelets are present and adequate in this field, some appearing slightly enlarged
No leukocytes, nucleated red cells or basophilic stippling in this field
66392.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows microcytic hypochromic red cells with widened central pallor and marked anisopoikilocytosis. Numerous elliptocytes and elongated pencil cells are present, together with scattered crenated cells likely representing artifact. Target cells and basophilic stippling are not prominent, and platelets appear adequate. Findings are consistent with iron deficiency anemia; correlation with ferritin and investigation of chronic blood loss are recommended.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia trait shows microcytosis disproportionate to anemia with frequent target cells and basophilic stippling, normal RDW and normal ferritin, whereas iron deficiency shows high RDW with pencil cells.
Hereditary elliptocytosis shows uniformly normochromic elliptocytes without hypochromia and is lifelong with normal iron studies.
Anemia of inflammation is usually normocytic to mildly microcytic with little poikilocytosis and high or normal ferritin.
Myelofibrosis shows teardrop cells with a leukoerythroblastic picture rather than hypochromic pencil cells.

66008.recognize_zh: 臨床照片可見手掌面食指遠端指節呈界線清楚的紫藍色發紺，其餘手指大致正常、僅中指指尖輕微暗紅，指紋紋路保留而無潰瘍或壞死，符合雷諾氏現象（Raynaud's phenomenon）的發紺期。
features: Clinical photograph of the palmar hand, not a microscopic image
Sharply demarcated violaceous-cyanotic discoloration confined to the distal phalanx of one finger
Relative sparing of adjacent digits, with only faint dusky mottling of a neighboring fingertip
Preserved epidermal ridge pattern without ulceration, eschar, gangrene or digital pitting
No splinter hemorrhages, purpura or livedo racemosa elsewhere on the visible hand
66008.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the palmar surface of the hand shows sharply demarcated violaceous cyanosis of the distal phalanx of a single finger, with relative sparing of the adjacent digits. The skin surface and dermatoglyphic ridges are intact, with no ulceration, necrosis, digital pitting or purpura. The appearance corresponds to the cyanotic phase of Raynaud's phenomenon; the reversibility and clinical history (fluoroquinolone exposure) support a vasospastic rather than fixed occlusive process. This image carries no hematopathologic morphology and should be interpreted with vascular, autoimmune and coagulation workup.

ddx.dx: Thrombotic or embolic digital ischemia (e.g., antiphospholipid syndrome, cholesterol emboli)
ddx.vs: Occlusive ischemia is persistent rather than episodic and tends to progress to fixed necrosis, ulceration or splinter hemorrhages.
Cryoglobulinemic vasculitis often shows palpable purpura and ulcers, and cold agglutinin disease is accompanied by hemolysis and red cell agglutination on smear.
A subcutaneous hematoma is non-blanching, evolves in color over days and is not triggered or relieved by temperature changes.

66072.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片中有一團大型淋巴樣細胞，核大而圓、染色質細緻，周圍一圈深藍色（嗜鹼性）胞質，細胞遠大於周圍的小淋巴球與凋亡細胞，呈芽細胞樣外觀，符合 DLBCL 侵犯中樞神經。
features: Aggregate of large atypical lymphoid cells, several times the diameter of background small lymphocytes
Round-to-oval nuclei with finely dispersed blastoid chromatin and very high N:C ratio
Thin rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Cells cluster loosely with molding from cytocentrifugation; no true cohesive glandular structures
Scattered small dark pyknotic/apoptotic cells and small lymphocytes in a clean background
66072.describe_en: CSF cytospin shows a cluster of large atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed blastoid chromatin, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and a thin rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Scattered small lymphocytes and pyknotic cells are present in the background. No red cells or glandular structures are seen. Findings are suggestive of CSF involvement by a high-grade lymphoma, consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in the appropriate clinical context; confirmation by flow cytometry and clonality studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma and embryonal tumor cells form truly cohesive three-dimensional clusters with nuclear molding and lack CD45/B-cell markers, whereas lymphoma cells are discohesive and CD45/CD20-positive.

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia (lymphoblastic or myeloid) in CSF
ddx.vs: Blasts have similar morphology and are separated by immunophenotype (TdT/CD34 or myeloid markers versus mature CD20+ B cells).
Reactive lymphocytes form a spectrum with small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid forms, lack uniform blastoid chromatin and show polyclonal flow cytometry.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with multiple small nucleoli and prominent cytoplasmic lipid vacuoles, which are not seen here.

65816.recognize_zh: 視野中白血球密集，可見骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀核與分節嗜中性球等各成熟階段並存，中央還有一顆含橘紅色粗顆粒的嗜伊紅性球（eosinophil），這種左移加嗜伊紅性球增多的組合符合 CML。
features: Marked leukocytosis with granulocytes at all stages of maturation
Numerous myelocytes with round to oval eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and lilac granular cytoplasm
Metamyelocytes and bands with kidney-shaped or horseshoe nuclei, plus segmented neutrophils
An eosinophil (orange-red refractile granules) in the center of the field
Occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles in immature granulocytes; blasts not increased in this field
Increased platelets; red cells normocytic with central pallor
65816.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with a continuous spectrum of granulocytic maturation, consisting predominantly of myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils. An eosinophil is present centrally, and blasts are not increased in this field. Granulocytes show normal granulation without dysplastic nuclear features. Platelets are numerous and red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, chronic phase.

ddx.vs: Reactive neutrophilia shows toxic granulation and Dohle bodies with fewer myelocytes and no absolute eosinophilia or basophilia.
aCML has conspicuous dysgranulopoiesis and lacks the orderly maturation and eosinophil/basophil increase seen here; BCR::ABL1 testing separates them.
CMML has an absolute monocytosis (monocytes 10% or more) with dysplasia rather than a myelocyte-predominant left shift.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase gene fusion
ddx.vs: These neoplasms show prominent eosinophilia and PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangement rather than BCR::ABL1.

65560.recognize_zh: 一顆白血球細胞質內塞滿約二十顆小型橢圓酵母樣體，每顆有偏位的新月形深藍色核與透明暈（pseudocapsule），把宿主細胞核擠到一側；吞噬細胞內的這種形態是周邊血液中播散性組織漿菌症（Histoplasma）等真菌血症的典型表現。
features: Single leukocyte (likely monocyte/neutrophil) with the nucleus compressed to one side
Cytoplasm packed with approximately 20 small oval yeast-like organisms (about 2-4 µm)
Each organism shows a crescent-shaped, eccentric basophilic nucleus with a clear surrounding halo
No hyphae or pseudohyphae; no definite central septa
Background red cells with a few irregular/crenated forms
65560.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a leukocyte whose nucleus is displaced to the periphery by numerous intracytoplasmic, small oval yeast-like organisms. The organisms are uniform, measure a fraction of a red cell diameter, and have eccentric crescentic basophilic nuclei with surrounding clear halos (pseudocapsules). No hyphae or septate forms are seen. Findings are consistent with phagocytosed fungal organisms indicating systemic fungemia, morphologically most suggestive of Histoplasma capsulatum; culture, urine/serum antigen or molecular testing is needed for definitive identification.

ddx.vs: Intracellular yeasts show a distinct central transverse septum from fission and elongated forms, which are not seen here.
Each amastigote has a nucleus plus a small rod-shaped kinetoplast and no halo.
Candida yeasts are larger, stain uniformly without crescentic nuclei, and may bud or form pseudohyphae.
These are homogeneous dense granules without an internal crescentic nucleus or clear capsule-like halo.

65624.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液 cytospin 中巨噬細胞細胞質塞滿大小不一、深洋紅色的球狀包涵體，每顆周圍有透明暈（A–C），並可見細胞外成堆的相同包涵體（D），而嗜中性球與淋巴球內沒有（E–F）；此為黏多醣症（Hurler 症候群）的溶體內糖胺聚醣堆積（Alder-Reilly 型包涵體）。
features: Macrophages with abundant cytoplasm packed with numerous large, round to polygonal, deep magenta globular inclusions (panels A-C)
Each inclusion individually surrounded by a clear halo, imparting a cobblestone or organism-like appearance
Macrophage nucleus pale and displaced, partly obscured by inclusions
Extracellular aggregate of identical halo-ringed inclusions from a ruptured macrophage (panel D)
Neutrophil without inclusions but hypersegmented with thin filamentous interlobar strands (panel E); lymphocyte without inclusions (panel F)
Background red cells from peripheral blood contamination
65624.describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytospin shows macrophages whose cytoplasm is distended by numerous large, deep magenta globular inclusions, each surrounded by a distinct clear halo. Similar inclusions are also present as extracellular aggregates, likely released from macrophages disrupted during preparation. Neutrophils and lymphocytes lack comparable inclusions, although a neutrophil shows hypersegmentation with long thin filamentous chromatin strands. In a child with Hurler syndrome, findings are consistent with lysosomal glycosaminoglycan storage (Alder-Reilly-type inclusions) within CSF macrophages; the halo-ringed inclusions should not be mistaken for intracellular organisms or staining artifact.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have crescentic basophilic nuclei within a halo and Leishmania shows nucleus plus kinetoplast, whereas these inclusions are homogeneous magenta globules without internal structure.

ddx.dx: Siderophages or hemosiderin-laden macrophages after hemorrhage
ddx.vs: Hemosiderin appears as golden-brown to blue-black irregular granules that are Prussian blue positive rather than uniform magenta globules with halos.
Morphology can overlap; distinction relies on treatment history and the underlying enzyme deficiency rather than appearance.
Apoptotic bodies are dense pyknotic nuclear fragments and precipitate lies on top of cells, unlike uniform halo-ringed cytoplasmic globules.

65240.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片可見顆粒球與紅血球系前驅細胞，部分細胞質含細小透明空泡，並有大型帶顆粒的前髓細胞；在 UBA1 突變病人中，這些前驅細胞空泡支持 VEXAS。背景有拉扯變形的核絲（crush artifact）。
features: Mixed granulocytic precursors including a large promyelocyte with abundant azurophilic granules
Erythroid precursors with round dense nuclei and blue to polychromatic cytoplasm
Fine clear cytoplasmic vacuoles in some myeloid precursors
Mature neutrophils with coarse granulation
Streaked, stretched nuclear chromatin strands (smear crush artifact)
65240.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows maturing granulocytic precursors, including large granulated promyelocytes and myelocytes, together with erythroid precursors at various stages. Several myeloid precursors show fine clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, and mature neutrophils show coarse granulation. Stretched nuclear chromatin strands reflect smearing artifact. Blasts are not increased in this field. In a patient with a UBA1 p.Met41Leu variant, findings are consistent with the marrow changes of VEXAS syndrome.

ddx.vs: Morphology of vacuolated precursors overlaps, so low serum copper/ceruloplasmin and absence of UBA1 mutation separate it.
APL shows sheets of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with Auer rods and bilobed nuclei, rather than normal maturing granulopoiesis.
Sepsis vacuoles involve mature neutrophils in peripheral blood rather than marrow myeloid and erythroid precursors.

65304.recognize_zh: 四格骨髓抹片中，組織球細胞質內聚集粉紅色細沙狀顆粒並把核推向一側（B–D），A 格可見吞噬有核細胞的噬血現象，D 格顆粒狀組織球旁有漿細胞；這種含細菌與碎屑顆粒的「typhoidal cells」原見於傷寒，本例為布氏桿菌病（brucellosis）。
features: Histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm containing clustered pink, fine sand-like granular material (panels B-D)
Nuclei displaced to one side by the granular cytoplasmic aggregates (panels C and D)
Hemophagocytosis: histiocyte engulfing nucleated cells (panel A)
Background granulocytic cells including band and segmented neutrophils
Occasional plasma cell and small lymphocyte (panel D); normochromic red cells
65304.describe_en: Four-panel bone marrow aspirate composite shows granulocytic hyperplasia with scattered histiocytes. Panel A shows a histiocyte engulfing nucleated hematopoietic cells, and panels B-D show histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm containing clustered fine pink sand-like granular material that displaces the nucleus; individual organisms cannot be resolved at this magnification. A plasma cell and mature neutrophils are present in the background. These 'typhoidal cells' with hemophagocytosis are suggestive of intracellular bacterial infection, in this case Brucella melitensis confirmed by serology and blood culture.

ddx.vs: Typhoid fever produces morphologically identical typhoidal cells, so the distinction rests on exposure history, serology and blood or marrow culture.
Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo with a crescent nucleus, and Leishman-Donovan bodies show a nucleus plus a bar-shaped kinetoplast, rather than amorphous pink granules.
Primary HLH shows hemophagocytosis without granular bacterial aggregates and is associated with genetic defects in cytotoxic function.
Gaucher cells have fibrillar 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than clustered pink granules and phagocytosed cells.

65176.recognize_zh: 臂神經叢神經根切片中，小淋巴球與漿細胞樣淋巴球沿神經束浸潤，CD20 陽性細胞遠多於散在的 CD3 T 細胞，Congo red 螢光下可見沿神經纖維的線狀澱粉樣沉積，符合淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤合併澱粉樣變性。
features: Nerve root fascicle with streaming and perivascular infiltrates of small lymphoid cells along the endoneurium
High power: small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and clumped chromatin; no large atypical cells
CD20 highlights dense sheets and bands of B cells, outnumbering scattered CD3-positive T cells
Congo red under fluorescence shows linear fibrillar positive deposits along nerve fibers, consistent with amyloid
65176.describe_en: Brachial plexus nerve root biopsy shows infiltration of the nerve fascicle by bands and perivascular collections of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells without large cell transformation. Immunostains show that the infiltrate is predominantly CD20-positive B cells with only scattered CD3-positive T cells. Congo red stain examined under fluorescence reveals linear amyloid deposits within the nerve. In conjunction with kappa light chain restriction and MYD88 L265P, findings are consistent with neurolymphomatosis by lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma with associated amyloid deposition.

ddx.dx: Chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy / reactive neuritis
ddx.vs: Inflammatory neuritis shows a T-cell and macrophage predominant infiltrate without clonal B cells or light chain restriction.
MZL can show plasmacytic differentiation and overlaps morphologically, but MYD88 L265P and an IgM paraprotein strongly favor lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.dx: AL amyloidosis due to plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: A plasma cell neoplasm lacks the CD20-positive clonal B-cell component and is usually IgG/IgA or light-chain only rather than IgM with MYD88 mutation.
DLBCL shows sheets of large cells with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli and a high Ki-67, not small lymphoplasmacytic cells.

65176.stain: H&E; IHC: CD3, CD20; Congo red (fluorescence)

64984.recognize_zh: PET 全身投影顯示頸、腋下、腹主動脈旁與骨盆多處小型 FDG 攝取淋巴結及脾臟瀰漫攝取增加；周邊血可見大型異常淋巴球，染色質粗糙、細胞質深藍且有細胞質突起，屬 EBV 相關淋巴增生的活化淋巴母細胞樣細胞。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cells, 2-3 times red cell diameter, with high to moderate N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved
Intensely basophilic cytoplasm, focally with cytoplasmic blebs/protrusions
No cytoplasmic granules; background red cells show mild anisocytosis without clear rouleaux in these crops
PET MIP: widespread small FDG-avid lymph nodes (cervical, axillary, abdominal, pelvic) and diffusely avid enlarged spleen
64984.describe_en: The PET maximum-intensity projection shows widespread small-volume FDG-avid lymphadenopathy above and below the diaphragm and a diffusely FDG-avid spleen. The peripheral blood film shows large atypical lymphoid cells with coarse chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some with cytoplasmic blebs, resembling activated lymphocytes/immunoblasts. Rouleaux formation is not well demonstrated in these cropped fields. These findings are nonspecific morphologically but, in the context of a high EBV viral load and polytypic flow cytometry, are suggestive of an EBV-driven lymphoproliferative disorder; lymph node biopsy is required.

ddx.dx: Relapsed lymphoma with leukemic phase (e.g., DLBCL)
ddx.vs: Clonal disease shows light chain restriction or IGH rearrangement, which were absent here.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells and occur in a primary infection without the widespread nodal/splenic PET avidity of this immunosuppressed patient.
Plasma cells show eccentric nuclei with perinuclear hof and are CD138+/CD38 bright, rather than CD19+ CD23+ activated B cells.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia or other circulating B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: HCL cells have pale cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections and a CD11c/CD25/CD103 phenotype rather than basophilic blebbed cytoplasm.

65048.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中散布多個破碎紅血球（schistocytes），包括頭盔狀（helmet cell）與三角形碎片（黑箭頭），血小板稀少，並見一顆嗜伊紅性白血球（紅箭頭），提示微血管病性溶血（MAHA），符合溶血性尿毒症候群的背景。
features: Numerous schistocytes per high-power field, including helmet cells, triangular and irregular fragments (black arrow)
Anisocytosis with scattered microspherocyte-like and crenated fragments
Platelets appear sparse in this field
Single eosinophil with bilobed nucleus and orange-red granules (red arrow)
Remaining red cells normochromic with central pallor
65048.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with anisocytosis and numerous fragmented red cells, including helmet cells and triangular and irregular schistocytes (black arrow). Platelets appear decreased in this field. An eosinophil is present (red arrow); no nucleated red cells or immature leukocytes are seen. Findings are consistent with a microangiopathic hemolytic process, in keeping with Shiga toxin-associated hemolytic uremic syndrome in the clinical context.

ddx.vs: TTP shows the same schistocytes and thrombocytopenia, so it is distinguished by severely reduced ADAMTS13 activity (<10%) rather than morphology.
DIC produces schistocytes too but is separated by prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen and high D-dimer, which are usually normal or mildly abnormal in HUS.
Valve-related fragmentation and burn-related microspherocytes arise in a specific clinical setting without thrombocytopenia and renal failure.

64792.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸見中大型原始細胞，切片呈原始細胞片狀增生，免疫染色 CD34 陽性、MPO 與 CD3 各有部分細胞陽性；流式顯示同一群原始細胞（紅色）同時表現 MPO 與強度接近正常 T 細胞的細胞質 CD3，CD19/cCD79a 陰性，符合 T/骨髓混合表型急性白血病（MPAL）。
features: Aspirate: medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm among hemodiluted marrow
Trephine H&E: hypercellular marrow with sheets of immature blasts
IHC: CD34 membranous positivity in blasts; MPO positive in a subset; CD3 positive in a subset
Flow: single blast population (red) co-expressing MPO and bright cytoplasmic CD3 (intensity similar to residual T cells) with surface CD3 negative
Flow: blasts negative for CD19 and cytoplasmic CD79a, excluding B-lineage
64792.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows increased medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio and fine chromatin, and the trephine biopsy is hypercellular with sheets of blasts. Immunohistochemistry shows the blasts to be CD34-positive, with subsets positive for MPO and CD3. Flow cytometry demonstrates a single blast population co-expressing MPO and cytoplasmic CD3 at an intensity comparable to normal T cells, with surface CD3, CD19 and cytoplasmic CD79a negative. These findings fulfill criteria for mixed-phenotype acute leukemia, T/myeloid; in this case NGS identified biallelic CEBPA mutations.

ddx.dx: AML with aberrant CD7 or weak cCD3
ddx.vs: AML may express CD7 or dim cCD3, but T-lineage assignment in MPAL requires cCD3 at an intensity approaching normal T cells, as seen here.
ETP-ALL expresses stem/myeloid markers (CD34, CD117, CD13/33) but is MPO-negative, whereas these blasts are MPO-positive.
CEBPA-mutated AML lacks strong cCD3 expression; when T-lineage criteria are met the case is classified by immunophenotype as MPAL T/myeloid.
B/myeloid MPAL requires strong CD19 with CD79a/CD22/CD10 or PAX5, whereas these blasts are CD19 and cCD79a negative.

64792.stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E, IHC: CD34, MPO, CD3; flow cytometry

64600.recognize_zh: 背景散佈大量短桿狀細菌（bacilli），唯一的白血球細胞質淡而空泡化，內含數個與背景相同形態的桿菌，核被擠向一側呈新月形，代表細胞內吞噬細菌。
features: Single intact leukocyte of moderate size with a dense, clumped, crescent-shaped nucleus displaced to one side
Pale, vacuolated cytoplasm containing several small intracytoplasmic rod-shaped bacteria
Numerous extracellular short, plump bacilli scattered evenly through the background
Acellular, protein-poor background without red cells, suggesting a fluid/cytospin preparation or a heavily contaminated specimen
No yeast, parasites, or other organisms seen
64600.describe_en: The smear shows a sparsely cellular, pale background with numerous extracellular short, plump rod-shaped bacteria and no red blood cells. A single leukocyte with a dense, eccentrically compressed crescentic nucleus contains several intracytoplasmic bacilli within pale vacuolated cytoplasm. The dense compacted nucleus and phagocytic activity favor a degenerating phagocyte (neutrophil or monocyte) over a true lymphocyte, as lymphocytes are not professionally phagocytic; exact lineage cannot be established on this single cell. Findings are consistent with bacterial infection with intracellular organisms (gram-negative bacilli such as Klebsiella/Pseudomonas per the case context); Gram stain and culture are required for identification.

ddx.vs: Contamination produces many extracellular bacteria but organisms are not taken up inside intact phagocytes, whereas here bacilli are clearly intracytoplasmic.
Precipitate is irregular, refractile, and variable in size and lies on top of cells, whereas these particles are uniform rods of consistent size inside vacuoles.
Histoplasma forms oval 2-4 um yeasts with a clear halo and eccentric chromatin dot, unlike the slender uniform bacilli here that also abound extracellularly.

ddx.dx: Toxic neutrophil with Döhle bodies/vacuoles only
ddx.vs: Toxic vacuoles are empty clear spaces without organisms, whereas here discrete rod-shaped bacteria are visible within the vacuoles.

64536.recognize_zh: 原始細胞中大、細胞質淡藍，核有明顯凹陷、折疊呈杯口狀（cup-like）或不規則形，部分細胞質有小空泡；流式 HLA-DR 幾乎全陰性、CD45 弱陽性，HLA-DR 陰性不只見於 APL，也可見於 NPM1 突變 AML。
features: Medium to large blasts with moderate pale to deep blue agranular cytoplasm
Irregular nuclei with prominent folds, clefts, and cup-like invaginations
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not conspicuous
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; no Auer rods or heavy granulation seen
Flow: blast gate on low side scatter (91.5%); HLA-DR essentially negative (0.1%); CD45 uniformly dim-positive (99.9%)
Flow: CD34 histogram shows a broad peak with a gated fraction labeled 93.2%; positivity threshold is not clear from the plot
64536.describe_en: Smear panels show a population of medium to large blasts with moderate agranular blue cytoplasm, finely dispersed chromatin, and irregular nuclei with folds and cup-like invaginations; occasional cytoplasmic vacuoles are present and no Auer rods are identified. Flow cytometric histograms show a low side scatter blast population that is HLA-DR negative and dim CD45 positive, with a CD34 histogram whose positivity cannot be judged reliably without the gate threshold. The morphology is not that of hypergranular promyelocytes. Findings are consistent with HLA-DR-negative acute myeloid leukemia, which in this case represents AML with NPM1 mutation, confirmed by molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL also shows HLA-DR negativity and folded bilobed nuclei but typically has strong MPO, faggot cells, CD34/CD2 patterns, coagulopathy, and PML::RARA, so genetic testing is required.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles, are usually HLA-DR positive, and express CD14/CD64/CD11b.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and express TdT with B (CD19, CD79a) or T (cCD3) lineage markers rather than myeloid antigens.

64472.recognize_zh: CD45 對 SSC 散佈圖中，P3 閘門（藍色）圈出 SSC 低、CD45 弱至中度表現的族群，位置正好是芽細胞區；上方紅色 SSC 較高者為成熟顆粒球。
features: Dot plot of CD45 (APC-H7, log scale) versus side scatter (SSC-A, linear)
Gated P3 population (blue) with low SSC and dim-to-moderate CD45: the typical blast region
Large ungated population (red) with intermediate to high SSC and brighter CD45, corresponding to granulocytes
Minor CD45-negative/low events at low SSC, likely debris or non-hematopoietic cells
64472.describe_en: Flow cytometric CD45 versus side scatter plot of left knee joint fluid shows a distinct population with low side scatter and dim to moderate CD45 expression, gated as P3 and consistent with the blast gate. A larger population with higher side scatter and brighter CD45 represents admixed granulocytes. This plot identifies the gated blast population, whose lineage must be assigned with additional markers (CD34, CD117, CD13/CD33, MPO). Findings support the presence of a blast population in the joint fluid in the setting of acute myeloid leukemia.

64408.recognize_zh: H&E（A、B）顯示以脂肪為主的低細胞性骨髓；CD138（D）標出散在的漿細胞，CD31（C）同樣呈現散在的膜狀陽性單核細胞，並有血管內皮作為內建陽性對照，表示這些反應性漿細胞表現 CD31。
features: Hypocellular marrow with abundant adipose tissue and a bony trabecula (panel B)
Residual cellularity composed mainly of small round lymphoid-appearing cells, scattered erythroid cells and extravasated red cells
CD138 highlights scattered, non-clustered plasma cells with membranous staining (panel D)
CD31 shows membranous/cytoplasmic staining in scattered round cells with plasma cell size and distribution (panel C)
CD31 positivity in vascular endothelium serves as an internal positive control
64408.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy sections (H&E) show a markedly hypocellular marrow with predominance of fat, residual small lymphoid cells, scattered erythroid elements and interstitial hemorrhage; no blast aggregates or atypical infiltrates are identified. CD138 highlights scattered interstitial plasma cells without sheets or clusters. CD31 stains a similar population of scattered round cells in addition to vascular endothelial cells, which serve as internal control. Findings are consistent with CD31 expression by scattered, likely reactive plasma cells in a hypocellular marrow; clonality must be assessed with kappa/lambda staining.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cells form clusters, sheets or increased interstitial counts with light-chain restriction, whereas here CD138-positive cells are scattered and reported polyclonal.
Megakaryocytes and macrophages also express CD31 but are larger with distinct morphology and are CD138-negative, so correlation with the CD138 pattern is required.
Aplastic anemia also shows a hypocellular fatty marrow with residual lymphocytes and plasma cells; the IHC here does not distinguish it, which requires clinical, PB and cytogenetic correlation.
Hypocellular MDS shows dysplasia, possible increased CD34-positive blasts or clonal cytogenetic/NGS abnormalities, which were not found in this case.

64152.recognize_zh: 五顆成熟嗜中性球聚成一團，每顆外緣與細胞間隙都密密黏著血小板，形成嗜中性球—血小板聚集；血小板環繞嗜中性球是血小板衛星現象，應以檸檬酸鈉管重測血小板。
features: Aggregate of five mature segmented neutrophils
Numerous normal-sized platelets adherent to the outer membranes of all neutrophils and between them
Neutrophils show normal segmentation and fine pink granulation
Few free platelets in the adjacent background
Out-of-focus dark artifact at left; red cells normocytic
64152.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of five mature segmented neutrophils with numerous platelets adhering to their outer membranes and between adjacent cells, forming a neutrophil-platelet aggregate. The neutrophils are morphologically normal and the platelets are extracellular and normal in appearance. Free platelets in the background are scant. Findings are consistent with prominent platelet satellitism, which can cause spurious thrombocytopenia and occasionally spurious leukopenia on automated analyzers.

ddx.vs: Clumps are aggregates of platelets alone rather than platelets bound to neutrophil surfaces.
Neutrophil aggregates without a surrounding platelet rim, typically due to EDTA-dependent antibodies against leukocytes.
Platelets are scarce everywhere without adherence to leukocytes, and the low count persists in citrate or heparin samples.

64088.recognize_zh: 一顆漿細胞核偏心、細胞質呈深藍色，胞質內擠滿許多圓形淡染小空泡狀包涵體（Russell bodies），呈葡萄串樣，這就是 Mott 細胞；影像解析度有限，包涵體呈淡灰藍而非明顯粉紅。
features: Single plasma cell with eccentric nucleus and clumped chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm packed with numerous small, round, pale/clear globular inclusions (Russell bodies) in a grape-like pattern
Inclusions displace but do not obscure the nucleus
Background of well-spread red cells and small platelet clumps; no other nucleated cells in field
Low image resolution limits assessment of inclusion color and chromatin detail
64088.describe_en: Smear shows a thinly spread area with well-separated red cells and scattered platelet clumps. A single plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus and coarse chromatin has deeply basophilic cytoplasm filled with numerous small, round, pale globular inclusions consistent with Russell bodies, characteristic of a Mott cell. The image resolution is limited, and the surrounding marrow cellularity and plasma cell percentage cannot be assessed from this single field. Mott cells represent accumulation of retained immunoglobulin and are nonspecific, occurring in reactive plasmacytosis as well as in MGUS and plasma cell neoplasms.

ddx.vs: Flame cells have a diffuse magenta peripheral cytoplasmic hue with frayed edges rather than discrete round globular inclusions.
Dutcher bodies are intranuclear (cytoplasmic pseudoinclusions overlying the nucleus), whereas Russell bodies lie within the cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Vacuolated blasts or lymphoma cells (e.g., Burkitt)
ddx.vs: Burkitt cells have sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles with immature chromatin and no plasma cell features such as an eccentric nucleus with clock-face chromatin.
Artifactual or degenerative vacuoles are irregular and empty, whereas Russell bodies are uniform round globules that are PAS-positive and immunoglobulin-positive.

64024.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中，紅血球之間佈滿大量小而圓、深紫色、胞質極少的淋巴球，數量遠超過其他白血球，可見少數被壓扁的破碎細胞（smudge cells），呈現絕對淋巴球增多。
features: Marked increase in small, round lymphoid cells with dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Relatively monotonous population at low power
Rare smudge cells
Few neutrophils relative to lymphocytes
Low magnification and photographic quality limit assessment of chromatin and nucleoli
64024.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows marked absolute lymphocytosis composed predominantly of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed chromatin, and scant cytoplasm. Occasional smudge cells are present, and granulocytes are relatively few. Nuclear detail (chromatin pattern, nucleoli, nuclear contour) cannot be adequately assessed at this magnification and image quality. Findings are suggestive of a chronic lymphoproliferative disorder such as CLL; flow cytometric immunophenotyping is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: CLL shows small lymphocytes with soccer-ball chromatin and abundant smudge cells, and is confirmed by a CD5+/CD23+/dim sIg clonal B-cell population on flow.
MCL cells often have more irregular nuclear contours and are CD5+/CD23-/cyclin D1+, which morphology at this power cannot separate.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant basophilic cytoplasm and scalloping around red cells rather than a monotonous small-cell population.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of follicular or marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show cleaved (buttock) nuclei or villous cytoplasmic projections, respectively, and are CD5-negative on flow.

63576.recognize_zh: 血片紅血球大小與形狀差異極大：小型紅血球、橢圓與淚滴狀細胞、紅血球碎片及少數標靶細胞，並可見兩顆有核紅血球；加上 HbF 明顯升高，符合 β-地中海貧血中間型。
features: Marked anisocytosis with many microcytes and scattered small dense microspherocytic forms
Striking poikilocytosis: ovalocytes/elliptocytes, teardrop cells and fragmented red cells (schistocytes)
Occasional target cells and hypochromic cells
Two nucleated red blood cells with dense round nuclei and a thin rim of cytoplasm
Subtle polychromasia; platelets present
63576.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous microcytes, ovalocytes, dacrocytes, and red cell fragments, together with occasional target cells and hypochromic cells. Two nucleated red blood cells are present in this field, and mild polychromasia is noted. Leukocytes are not otherwise represented in this field. In conjunction with hemoglobin electrophoresis showing markedly increased HbF and elevated HbA2, the findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia intermedia.

ddx.vs: Morphology is similar but more severe with abundant nRBCs, and the distinction is clinical (transfusion dependence) and genotypic rather than morphologic.
HbH disease shows similar microcytic poikilocytosis but has HbH inclusions (golf-ball) on supravital staining and normal or low HbA2.
Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytes and pencil cells without nRBCs or basophilic stippling, with low ferritin and normal HbA2/HbF.
MAHA has schistocytes with thrombocytopenia and normocytic indices, without microcytosis or elevated HbF/HbA2.

63448.recognize_zh: 薄層血片中央的嗜中性球細胞核分葉不足（呈彎曲帶狀），淡色細胞質內有一小團棕黑色顆粒狀色素，即被吞噬的瘧色素（hemozoin），提示瘧疾感染；周圍紅血球內未見明顯寄生蟲。
features: Neutrophil with hyposegmented, band-like curved nucleus
Small aggregate of golden-brown to black granular pigment in the cytoplasm (hemozoin)
Pale cytoplasm with fine granules
No intraerythrocytic parasites visible in the surrounding red cells in this field
Background red cells normochromic with central pallor
63448.describe_en: Thin blood smear shows a neutrophil with a hyposegmented, band-like nucleus and a small cluster of golden-brown to black granular pigment within the cytoplasm, consistent with phagocytosed malarial pigment (hemozoin). Surrounding red cells show no intraerythrocytic parasites in this field. Pigment-containing neutrophils and monocytes indicate malaria infection and correlate with severity in P. falciparum; a careful search for parasitized red cells and parasitemia quantification is warranted.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are dark purple and diffusely distributed, and Döhle bodies are pale blue, whereas hemozoin is refractile golden-brown to black clumped pigment.
Precipitate lies on a different focal plane and is also found between cells, while hemozoin is intracytoplasmic and refractile.

ddx.dx: Intracellular organisms such as Anaplasma morulae or Histoplasma
ddx.vs: Morulae are basophilic stippled inclusions and Histoplasma yeasts are uniform ovoid bodies with halos, neither being brown refractile pigment.

63384.recognize_zh: 低倍血片中紅血球聚成大小不一的不規則團塊，並有明顯大小不均、數顆有核紅血球（NRBC）與嗜中性球；在此倍率下鐮刀形紅血球、標靶細胞與 Howell-Jolly 小體無法清楚辨認。
features: Irregular clumps of red cells (agglutinates) of varying size scattered throughout the smear
Marked anisocytosis with some small dense cells
Several nucleated red cells with dark round nuclei
Scattered neutrophils and occasional larger mononuclear cells; platelets present
Sickle cells, target cells and Howell-Jolly bodies not reliably resolved at this low magnification
63384.describe_en: Low-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows irregular clusters of agglutinated red cells with marked anisocytosis and scattered small dense red cells. Several nucleated red cells, neutrophils and platelets are present. At this magnification, sickle cells, target cells, polychromasia and Howell-Jolly bodies described in the case cannot be reliably assessed. Findings are consistent with red cell agglutination in a patient with a hemolytic anemia with circulating nucleated red cells; review of the thin area at high power and a direct antiglobulin test are recommended.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are orderly linear stacks of red cells in the thin area associated with high plasma proteins, rather than irregular three-dimensional clumps.

ddx.dx: Thick area of smear with red cell overlap
ddx.vs: Overlap is confined to the thick portion and resolves in the feathered edge, whereas agglutinates persist in thin areas.
Warm AIHA features spherocytes with IgG-positive DAT and usually lacks prominent red cell clumps.

63320.recognize_zh: 低倍下紅血球散在分布之外，可見多處不規則的紅血球團塊（黃線標示，agglutination），而數個嗜中性球周圍都緊貼一圈紅血球（綠線標示，rosetting）；這種分布提示紅血球表面有抗體或補體結合的免疫性溶血。
features: Low-power view of a peripheral smear with evenly spread red cells
Scattered irregular three-dimensional red cell clumps (agglutinates, yellow lines)
Several neutrophils each surrounded by a ring of adherent red cells (rosettes, green lines)
Agglutinates are irregular clusters rather than linear rouleaux stacks
Platelets present; low magnification precludes assessment of spherocytes or inclusions
63320.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows scattered irregular red cell agglutinates throughout the monolayer, along with several neutrophils surrounded by rosettes of adherent red cells. The clumps are irregular rather than linear stacks. Fine red cell morphology such as spherocytes cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of immune-mediated hemolytic anemia with antibody- or complement-coated red cells (for example, a cold agglutinin), and should be correlated with DAT and a smear prepared at 37 C.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux form linear coin-stack arrays in thick areas and disperse with saline, without rosetting around neutrophils.
Artifactual clumping resolves on a warmed or citrate specimen and is not associated with a positive DAT or hemolysis.
Erythrophagocytosis shows red cells within neutrophil cytoplasm rather than adherent around the cell surface.

63256.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血影像中一個嗜中性球，細胞質內有一個大而圓、邊界清楚的透明空泡，把分葉核擠壓成新月形，空泡內含淡粉紅色細顆粒；在脂肪栓塞的臨床背景下，這是吞噬脂肪球的嗜中性球，可用油紅 O 染色證實。
features: Single neutrophil with a large, round, sharply demarcated clear intracytoplasmic vacuole
Vacuole nearly the size of the nucleus, compressing the nuclear lobes into a crescent around it
Fine pink granular material within the vacuole
Coarsely clumped nuclear chromatin; faint neutrophilic granules in the surrounding pale cytoplasm
Background crenated red cells (echinocytic change)
63256.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a neutrophil containing a single large, round, sharply demarcated clear cytoplasmic vacuole that compresses the segmented nucleus into a crescent shape. The vacuole contains fine pink granular material, and the surrounding cytoplasm shows faint neutrophilic granules. Background red cells are crenated. This single large vacuole differs from the multiple small vacuoles of toxic change. In the setting of suspected fat embolism with fat particles in the sample, the finding is consistent with a neutrophil containing a phagocytosed fat globule; a fat stain (Oil red O or Sudan) is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Toxic vacuoles are small, multiple and irregular and accompany toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, rather than a single large round vacuole deforming the nucleus.
A phagocytosed red cell appears as a pink-orange homogeneous body with hemoglobin color, not a clear vacuole with fine granular content.

ddx.dx: Intracellular fungal organism (e.g., Candida or Histoplasma)
ddx.vs: Fungi show a defined cell wall and basophilic internal structure with a surrounding halo, and stain with PAS or GMS rather than fat stains.
Storage artifact causes small uniform vacuoles in many leukocytes and is absent on a freshly prepared smear.

63192.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中許多紅血球的中央淡染區變成狹長裂隙（口形紅血球，stomatocyte）；視野中央箭頭旁有一顆和紅血球差不多大、含紫色顆粒的巨大血小板（giant platelet），另見一般大小血小板與小血小板團。
features: Numerous stomatocytes with elongated slit- or mouth-like central pallor
Giant platelet near the arrow, approximately the size of an adjacent red cell, with purple granular cytoplasm
Normal-sized platelet and a small platelet clump elsewhere in the field
Remaining red cells normochromic discocytes with a few target-like forms
No nucleated red cells, schistocytes or spherocytes evident
63192.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows many red cells with elongated slit-like central pallor (stomatocytes), admixed with normochromic discocytes and a few target-like cells. A giant platelet approximately the size of an adjacent red cell, with granular purple cytoplasm, lies near the arrow, together with a normal-sized platelet and a small platelet aggregate. Schistocytes, spherocytes and polychromasia are not evident in this field. A consistent stomatocyte population together with macrothrombocytes raises the possibility of sitosterolemia (stomatocytosis with macrothrombocytopenia) or hereditary stomatocytosis, and plant sterol levels, platelet count and red cell indices are recommended. Findings are consistent with stomatocytosis with giant platelets.

ddx.vs: Artifactual slits occur only in thick smear areas, whereas true stomatocytes persist in the thin monolayer.
Shows giant platelets with Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions but without stomatocytosis.
Stomatocytic slits occur in oval macro-ovalocytes, often multiple or Y-shaped, rather than in round cells.
Accompanies macrocytosis, target cells and liver dysfunction without giant platelets.

63128.recognize_zh: Ki-67 染色中，許多大型異型細胞核呈不同強度的棕色陽性，並有少數強陽性核，代表增生指數偏高，支持低惡度濾泡性淋巴瘤已轉化為大細胞淋巴瘤。
features: IHC for Ki-67 on bone marrow biopsy at high power, adjacent to a bony trabecula (left)
Large atypical cells with irregular nuclei show nuclear staining in a substantial proportion
Staining intensity is variable, mostly weak to moderate with occasional strongly positive nuclei
Small negative nuclei (stromal/endothelial and residual cells) interspersed
Weak overall chromogen intensity limits precise quantification
63128.describe_en: Ki-67 immunostain at high power shows nuclear positivity in a substantial proportion of the large atypical lymphoid cells adjacent to a bony trabecula, with variable, mostly weak-to-moderate intensity and occasional strongly positive nuclei. Smaller spindle and stromal nuclei are negative. The weak staining intensity in this image limits exact enumeration, but the proliferation index is clearly elevated relative to low-grade follicular lymphoma. Findings support a high-grade (transformed) large B-cell lymphoma involving the marrow.

ddx.vs: Low-grade FL typically shows a Ki-67 index below about 20–30% in small cleaved cells, whereas transformation shows a high index in large cells.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Near-100% Ki-67 can raise concern for double-hit lymphoma, which requires FISH for MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 rather than morphology alone.
Burkitt shows monotonous medium-sized cells with starry-sky pattern, Ki-67 near 100%, BCL2 negative, and MYC rearrangement.

63064.recognize_zh: 在正常大小、有中央淡區的紅血球之間，散布許多明顯較小、染色深且沒有中央淡區的圓形細胞，即小球形紅血球（microspherocytes），可被分析儀誤計為血小板。
features: Numerous microspherocytes: small, dense, uniformly dark-staining round red cells lacking central pallor
Microspherocytes clearly smaller than adjacent normocytic discocytes
Background red cells normochromic with preserved central pallor
Rare platelet; no obvious schistocytes in this field
Photograph slightly out of focus, limiting assessment of fine fragments
63064.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a background of normocytic normochromic red cells with preserved central pallor, admixed with numerous small, dense, round red cells lacking central pallor (microspherocytes). Platelets appear sparse in this field and no leukocytes are present. Image focus limits evaluation for small fragments. Findings are consistent with microspherocytosis due to toxin-induced and microangiopathic red cell injury, which can spuriously elevate automated platelet counts.

ddx.vs: HS spherocytes are more uniform and less extremely small, with a chronic history, family history and negative DAT, rather than acute microspherocytes accompanying fragmentation in DIC.
Warm AIHA spherocytes are accompanied by polychromasia and a positive DAT, and lack the extreme small size of traumatic microspherocytes.
Burns produce identical microspherocytes plus budding fragments; distinction is clinical history.
Platelets have purple granular texture and no hemoglobin color, whereas microspherocytes are homogeneously orange-pink.

63000.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片網狀纖維染色（reticulin）下，左側與骨小樑周圍的浸潤區可見密集交錯的黑色網狀纖維，範圍廣泛；右側殘存造血區纖維較少，呈現局部明顯增加的纖維化（約 MF-2）。
features: Dense, diffuse network of intersecting black reticulin fibers in the infiltrated area (left and center)
Fibers form coarse bundles around a bony trabecula, without obvious collagen conversion at this stain
Adjacent residual hematopoietic area (right) with relatively sparse reticulin
Heterogeneous distribution of fibrosis, localized to the lesional infiltrate
No osteosclerosis evident on the single trabecula shown
63000.describe_en: Reticulin stain of the bone marrow trephine shows a dense, diffuse and intersecting network of reticulin fibers with focal coarse bundles in the region of the infiltrate adjacent to a bony trabecula. The residual hematopoietic marrow on the right shows only sparse reticulin. Fibrosis is heterogeneous and concentrated in the lesional area, grading approximately MF-2 of 3. Findings are consistent with localized reticulin fibrosis associated with a mast cell infiltrate in systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: PMF shows fibrosis distributed across the marrow with atypical clustered megakaryocytes, rather than fibrosis confined to a mast cell aggregate.
Desmoplastic metastasis shows keratin-positive tumor clusters within the fibrotic stroma.
HCL causes diffuse fine reticulin fibrosis (dry tap) with round CD20+ cells rather than spindled tryptase+ cells.

62936.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中聚集了一群分葉核白血球，細胞質內散在大小不一、粗大的深紫至黑色顆粒，右上角一個細胞含有更大的洋紅色顆粒；顆粒明顯比正常嗜中性顆粒粗大且分布不均，符合 Chediak-Higashi 顆粒，但此圖解析度與染色品質有限。
features: Clustered segmented granulocytes with coarse, irregularly distributed dark purple cytoplasmic granules
Granules variable in size, larger than normal neutrophilic granules
One cell (upper right) with larger magenta and dark inclusions
Nuclear segmentation preserved; no left shift in the field
Pale, poorly defined red cells and suboptimal staining/resolution limit detail
62936.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of segmented granulocytes containing coarse, irregular, variably sized dark purple cytoplasmic granules that are larger than normal neutrophilic granules; one cell at the upper right contains larger magenta inclusions. Nuclear segmentation is preserved without left shift. Staining quality and resolution are suboptimal, and red cell detail is poor. In the setting of giant granules in multiple leukocyte lineages with partial albinism, findings are consistent with Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine and evenly distributed, usually with Döhle bodies and vacuoles, rather than variably sized coarse inclusions.
Alder-Reilly granules are uniformly dense in all cells without the giant fused granules of Chediak-Higashi.
Precipitate lies over cells and background in a different focal plane, not confined to cytoplasm.

62872.recognize_zh: 四格 H&E 影像都呈現大片密集、形態一致的小型淋巴球浸潤，核小而深染、細胞質少，未見大型異型細胞或壞死，是惰性 T 細胞淋巴增生性疾病的單調小淋巴球浸潤模式。
features: Dense, diffuse sheets of small monotonous lymphocytes in all four panels
Small round to slightly irregular dark nuclei with scant cytoplasm
No large transformed cells, prominent nucleoli or necrosis identified
Scattered small vessels and stromal elements; epithelial structures not well seen at this resolution
62872.describe_en: Four H&E fields show a dense, diffuse infiltrate of small, monotonous lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Large atypical cells, brisk mitotic activity and necrosis are not identified, although image resolution limits assessment of nuclear detail and epitheliotropism. The appearance of a bland, monotonous small lymphoid infiltrate is consistent with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract in the appropriate immunophenotypic context.

ddx.vs: MEITL cells are medium-sized with more open chromatin, marked epitheliotropism and a high proliferation index.

ddx.dx: Small lymphocytic or mantle cell lymphoma involving gut
ddx.vs: These B-cell lymphomas look similar at low resolution but are CD20-positive (with CD5, and cyclin D1 in MCL), whereas this infiltrate is CD3-positive with rare B cells.
Reactive infiltrates are polymorphous with germinal centers and plasma cells and lack a clonal TCR rearrangement.

62808.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有多顆大型組織球，細胞質豐富、呈灰藍色並帶細纖維狀或皺紋紙樣紋路，細胞核小而偏位，混在顆粒球前驅細胞之間，符合偽高雪氏細胞（pseudo-Gaucher cells）。
features: Numerous large histiocytes with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm showing fine fibrillary/striated ('crumpled tissue paper') texture
Small round to oval, often eccentric nuclei within the histiocytes
Background of granulocytic precursors at various stages and scattered erythroid precursors
Occasional lobulated megakaryocyte/neutrophil forms; large fat spaces and smeared red cells
Image is a photomicrograph through the eyepiece with uneven focus, limiting fine detail
62808.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle-rich field with granulocytic precursors and scattered erythroid cells. Numerous large histiocytes are present with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm displaying a fine fibrillary, striated texture and small eccentric nuclei. The focus and illumination are uneven, limiting assessment of fine cytoplasmic detail. In the setting of chronic myeloid leukemia, findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells.

ddx.vs: Morphology is essentially identical; separation requires clinical context (underlying CML or other high cell-turnover neoplasm) and glucocerebrosidase enzyme/GBA testing.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules or vacuoles rather than a fibrillary striated cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial infection (e.g., M. avium complex) in histiocytes
ddx.vs: Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes show negative-image striations that are acid-fast positive on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Niemann-Pick cells have foamy, finely vacuolated cytoplasm rather than wrinkled fibrillary cytoplasm.

62744.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的中性球胞質內有一團均質、無結構的紫色圓形物，把細胞核擠到邊緣，形成紅斑性狼瘡細胞（LE cell）；右上角另有吞噬紅血球的巨噬細胞，提示自體免疫（SLE）背景下的血球吞噬現象。
features: Neutrophil containing a large homogeneous, smooth, purple inclusion that displaces its nucleus to the periphery (LE cell, arrow)
Engulfed body lacks chromatin texture, consistent with phagocytosed denatured nuclear material
Macrophage (upper right) with abundant cytoplasm containing ingested red cells (hemophagocytosis)
Background of mature neutrophils, small lymphocytes, and red cells with occasional rouleaux-like stacking
Few platelets visible, in keeping with thrombocytopenia
62744.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered maturing neutrophils and small lymphocytes in a background of abundant red cells. One neutrophil (arrow) contains a large, round, homogeneous, glassy purple inclusion devoid of chromatin structure that compresses the lobated nucleus to the cell periphery, characteristic of an LE cell. A macrophage in the upper right field contains phagocytosed erythrocytes, indicating hemophagocytosis. Findings are suggestive of systemic lupus erythematosus with LE cell formation and associated hemophagocytosis; correlation with ANA/anti-dsDNA and HLH criteria is recommended.

ddx.vs: In a tart cell the engulfed nucleus retains visible chromatin structure and is ingested by a monocyte/macrophage, whereas the LE body is homogeneous and structureless within a neutrophil.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil with phagocytosed apoptotic cell or bacteria
ddx.vs: Apoptotic bodies are smaller, dense, and often fragmented, and bacteria are small discrete rods or cocci rather than a single large smooth hematoxylin body.
Hemophagocytosis alone is nonspecific; the presence of LE cells and serologic evidence of lupus point to macrophage activation secondary to SLE.

62680.recognize_zh: C-MYC 染色中，約三到四成的淋巴細胞核呈強弱不等的核染色，分布不均，其餘細胞核為陰性；未達高表現（通常以 ≥40% 為界）則不特別提示 MYC 重排。
features: Nuclear c-MYC staining in a subset of lymphoid cells, estimated roughly 30-40%
Intensity variable, from weak to strong
Positive cells distributed unevenly, somewhat clustered in the lower and right portions
Remaining small-to-medium lymphoid nuclei negative (hematoxylin counterstain)
No cytoplasmic staining
62680.describe_en: C-MYC immunohistochemistry shows nuclear staining of variable intensity in a subset of lymphoid cells, estimated at roughly 30-40% in this field, with the remaining nuclei negative. Positive cells are unevenly distributed. MYC protein expression at this level is not specific for MYC rearrangement and should be interpreted with FISH if high-grade transformation is suspected. Findings are compatible with the reported follicular lymphoma, with a moderate proliferative/MYC-expressing fraction.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma usually has high-grade morphology with MYC expression in most cells and requires FISH confirmation of both rearrangements.
Burkitt lymphoma shows MYC expression in nearly all cells with Ki-67 near 100% and BCL2 negativity.
Reactive germinal centers contain scattered MYC-positive cells in a polarized distribution with BCL2-negative germinal center cells.

62616.recognize_zh: 臨床照片：頭皮上多發紫紅至深褐色的斑塊與小丘疹，大小不一，部分融合，外觀最像卡波西肉瘤（Kaposi sarcoma）；提示病人有 KSHV/HHV8 感染（常見於 HIV 病人），這是懷疑原發性積液淋巴瘤時的重要臨床線索。
features: Multiple violaceous to dark brown macules, papules and small plaques on the scalp
Lesions vary in size from a few millimeters to about 2 cm, with some coalescence
Well-demarcated, non-ulcerated surfaces with a faint bluish hue in the largest lesion
No visible effusion-related findings; clinical photograph only
62616.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the scalp shows multiple violaceous to dark brown macules, papules and small plaques of variable size, some coalescing, without ulceration. The appearance is most suggestive of cutaneous Kaposi sarcoma. The photograph itself does not demonstrate the effusion lymphoma; its relevance is that Kaposi sarcoma indicates KSHV/HHV8 infection, which frequently coexists with primary effusion lymphoma, particularly in HIV-positive patients. Biopsy with HHV8 LANA-1 immunostaining is required for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous lymphoma infiltrate (e.g., extracavitary PEL or leukemia cutis)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma or leukemia cutis usually forms plum-colored nodules and requires biopsy showing CD45+ neoplastic lymphoid or myeloid cells rather than an HHV8+ spindle-cell vascular proliferation.
Bacillary angiomatosis shows lobular capillary proliferation with neutrophils and Warthin-Starry-positive bacilli and is HHV8-negative.
Purpura is flat, non-palpable and evolves in color over days, and biopsy shows only extravasated red cells without a spindle-cell proliferation.

62552.recognize_zh: CD20 在幾乎所有中大型腫瘤細胞呈強而完整的細胞膜環狀染色，確認為 B 細胞淋巴瘤；但 CD20 本身無法區分 Burkitt、DLBCL 與雙打擊淋巴瘤。
features: Strong, complete membranous CD20 staining in the large majority of tumor cells
Medium to large cells with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm outlined by membrane staining
Diffuse sheet-like distribution without a follicular pattern
Occasional negative spaces corresponding to vessels and macrophages
62552.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry shows strong, diffuse membranous staining of the sheets of medium to large neoplastic cells, confirming a B-cell lineage. The positive cells are arranged diffusely without a follicular distribution, and unstained gaps correspond to vessels and interspersed macrophages. This supports an aggressive mature B-cell lymphoma; distinction between Burkitt lymphoma, DLBCL and high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements requires BCL2, Ki67 and FISH.

ddx.vs: Also CD20-positive; separated by BCL2 negativity, Ki67 near 100% and isolated MYC rearrangement.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is CD20-negative and CD138/MUM1-positive.
T-LBL is CD20-negative and positive for CD3 and TdT.

62488.recognize_zh: CD34 染色下血管呈分枝狀線性陽性，另有散在的圓形 CD34+ 母細胞，未形成大團塊；背景可見許多 CD34 陰性的小型巨核細胞，符合 CML 加速期的骨髓。
features: Branching linear CD34 positivity in capillary endothelium
Scattered individual round CD34-positive blasts with membranous staining, without large clusters
Numerous CD34-negative megakaryocytes, many small with pale cytoplasm
Hypercellular marrow with myeloid cells negative for CD34
62488.describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemical stain on a hypercellular bone marrow core biopsy highlights a branching capillary network and scattered individual CD34-positive blasts. Blasts do not form large clusters or sheets in this field. Numerous CD34-negative megakaryocytes, many of them small, are present in the background. Findings support a modest increase in blasts without focal blast aggregates, compatible with CML in accelerated phase when correlated with aspirate blast count.

ddx.vs: Blast phase would show large aggregates or sheets of CD34-positive blasts, or at least 20% blasts overall.
MDS/MPN overlap neoplasms show dysplasia with normal or large megakaryocytes and are BCR::ABL1 negative.
PMF has large, bizarre, hyperchromatic megakaryocytes with cloud-like nuclei rather than small hypolobated forms, and is BCR::ABL1 negative.

62424.recognize_zh: 這張不是電泳圖，而是一名孩童坐姿的臨床照片：右膝明顯腫大呈球狀、左膝也有腫脹輪廓，兩側大腿肌肉相對消瘦；兒童反覆膝關節腫脹合併肌肉萎縮，符合血友病關節病變（hemophilic arthropathy）/關節內出血。
features: Marked globular swelling of the right knee
Swelling and bulbous contour of the contralateral knee
Relative wasting of the thigh and calf musculature, accentuating the knees
Knee held in partial flexion
No visible skin ulceration, bruising or deformity elsewhere in the photograph
62424.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a seated child with marked globular swelling of the right knee and a swollen, bulbous contour of the left knee, held in partial flexion. There is relative wasting of the thigh and calf muscles. No overlying skin lesions or bruising are evident. Note that the record legend describes an agarose gel (inverse shift PCR), which does not match this image; the image is a clinical photograph. The appearance is suggestive of hemarthrosis/chronic hemophilic arthropathy in the context of hemophilia A.

ddx.vs: Septic arthritis is usually monoarticular with erythema, warmth and fever, and joint aspirate shows purulent fluid rather than blood.
JIA causes symmetric synovitis without bleeding history, with normal coagulation studies and inflammatory synovial fluid.
Sickle crises present with pain and dactylitis in the setting of hemolytic anemia and sickle cells on smear, not isolated prolonged aPTT.

62360.recognize_zh: 絕大多數腫瘤細胞核呈強棕色 Ki-67 陽性，陰性的藍色核主要是散在的間質細胞，顯示腫瘤增殖指數極高。
features: Strong diffuse nuclear Ki-67 staining in the vast majority of tumor cells
Positive nuclei are oval to irregular with coarse speckled staining pattern
Scattered negative (blue) nuclei, mostly smaller spindled stromal/endothelial cells
Estimated proliferation index very high (well above 80% of tumor cells)
62360.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for Ki-67 shows strong nuclear positivity in the vast majority of tumor cells, with negative nuclei largely confined to interspersed stromal and endothelial cells. The proliferation index is very high. This supports a highly proliferative lymphoblastic neoplasm and, in the context of CD3 and TdT positivity, is consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma; a high Ki-67 index alone is not specific for lineage.

ddx.vs: Burkitt also shows near-100% Ki-67 but is a CD20+ CD10+ BCL2-negative TdT-negative B-cell lymphoma with MYC rearrangement.
DLBCL can have a high Ki-67 but is composed of large CD20+ B cells and is TdT-negative.

62104.recognize_zh: 白血球極度增多的抹片中，大量中大型細胞的核呈雙葉、蝴蝶狀或腎形折疊，細胞質淡藍灰、幾乎看不到明顯顆粒，這種「雙葉核＋少顆粒」的外觀是微顆粒型 APL（M3v）的線索。
features: Marked leukocytosis with numerous medium-to-large abnormal cells
Characteristic bilobed, butterfly or reniform folded nuclei
Fine chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous to small
Scant to moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with few or no visible azurophilic granules
Occasional faint cytoplasmic granularity in rare cells; Auer rods not evident in this field
Background red cells without obvious schistocytes
62104.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked hyperleukocytosis composed predominantly of medium-to-large abnormal cells. The cells have characteristically bilobed or butterfly-shaped, folded nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and a moderate amount of pale gray-blue cytoplasm that appears hypogranular to agranular by light microscopy. No Auer rod bundles are identified in this field. Findings are suggestive of the microgranular (hypogranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; strong MPO positivity, CD34-/HLA-DR- immunophenotype, and PML::RARA testing are needed, and coagulopathy should be anticipated.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei too, but are usually NSE-positive, weakly MPO-positive, and HLA-DR positive, whereas M3v cells are strongly MPO-positive and HLA-DR negative.
Classic APL shows abundant coarse granules obscuring the nucleus and frequent faggot cells, while this field shows hypogranular cytoplasm with bilobed nuclei.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of lymphoma with cleaved nuclei (e.g., mantle cell, Sezary)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells have coarser chromatin and lack MPO, and flow cytometry shows mature B- or T-cell phenotype.

62040.recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色高倍下，絕大多數小淋巴球與數顆核淡染的大型細胞皆為陰性，僅一顆中型細胞呈強陽性；在未知抗體的情況下，這張圖主要呈現大細胞的「陰性」結果，須對照標記名稱判讀。
features: Background of small to intermediate lymphocytes negative for the marker
Scattered large cells with vesicular nuclei and pale chromatin that are also unstained
A single intermediate-to-large cell with strong cytoplasmic/membranous red staining
Faint granular red background deposits, possibly non-specific or dendritic/extracellular staining
Antibody identity not labeled in the image
62040.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at high power shows a background of small to intermediate lymphocytes and scattered large vesicular cells that are negative for the marker. Only a single intermediate-to-large cell shows strong cytoplasmic and membranous staining, and there is faint granular background deposition. Because the antibody is not identified, the pattern cannot be definitively interpreted; if this is CD30 or CD15, the lack of staining in the large cells would support LP cells of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, with the single positive cell likely a reactive immunoblast or granulocyte. Correlation with the case's labeled immunopanel is required.

ddx.vs: In LRCHL the large HRS cells would be strongly CD30+ (membrane and Golgi) and often CD15+, rather than negative as the large cells are here.
THRLBCL large cells are also CD30-/CD15-, so separation depends on architecture and the T-cell composition (CD8+ versus PD-1+ rosettes) rather than this stain.
ALCL shows sheets or sinusoidal clusters of large hallmark cells with uniform strong CD30 staining, not a single isolated positive cell.

61976.recognize_zh: CD30 免疫染色中，密集的小到中型淋巴球幾乎全為陰性，只有視野中央一個較大的細胞呈細胞膜陽性，另有少數弱陽性細胞；CD30 陽性大細胞極少，是 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病與 CD30+ 淋巴增生性疾病的重要區別點。
features: Dense infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Vast majority of cells CD30-negative
Single large cell with crisp membranous CD30 staining in the center of the field
Rare additional cells with weak, granular or dendritic-appearing staining
No clusters or sheets of CD30-positive large cells
61976.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD30 on a skin biopsy shows a dense infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells that are predominantly negative. Only a rare large cell shows crisp membranous staining, with a few additional cells showing weak staining; no clusters or sheets of CD30-positive cells are present. The paucity of CD30-positive large cells argues against a primary cutaneous CD30-positive lymphoproliferative disorder. Findings are consistent with primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder in the appropriate morphologic and immunophenotypic context.

ddx.vs: Lymphomatoid papulosis contains numerous scattered or clustered large CD30+ cells in a wedge-shaped mixed infiltrate with recurrent self-healing papules, unlike rare positive cells here.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Cutaneous ALCL shows sheets of large anaplastic cells with more than 75% CD30 positivity.
Transformed mycosis fungoides has large cells exceeding 25% of the infiltrate, often CD30-positive, and a clinical history of patches and plaques.

61912.recognize_zh: TIA-1染色下，皮下脂肪與真皮內的淋巴樣浸潤中許多細胞呈細胞質顆粒狀棕色陽性，顯示浸潤細胞具細胞毒性表型；HV-LPD的腫瘤細胞通常是細胞毒性T或NK細胞，TIA-1陽性支持此點，但仍需EBER確認。
features: Numerous lymphoid cells with granular cytoplasmic TIA-1 positivity
Positive cells are small to medium-sized, distributed diffusely in the dermis and between subcutaneous adipocytes
Dot-like and granular staining pattern typical of cytotoxic granule-associated protein
Admixed negative lymphoid and stromal nuclei; epithelial structure at left negative
61912.describe_en: TIA-1 immunohistochemistry on the dermal and subcutaneous lymphoid infiltrate shows granular cytoplasmic staining in a large proportion of small to medium-sized lymphocytes distributed interstitially and between adipocytes. Admixed negative cells and stromal elements are present, and the adnexal epithelium at left is negative. The findings indicate a cytotoxic phenotype of the infiltrate. Together with EBER positivity, this cytotoxic T/NK-cell infiltrate is consistent with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: ENKTL is also TIA-1-positive and EBER-positive, so separation relies on clinical setting, cytologic pleomorphism, angiodestruction and extensive necrosis.
SPTCL is cytotoxic (TIA-1-positive) as well but is EBER-negative and shows CD8+ beta-F1+ cells rimming adipocytes restricted to the subcutis.
Conventional MF usually has a CD4+ non-cytotoxic phenotype with TIA-1 negativity and epidermotropism, and is EBER-negative.

61848.recognize_zh: 成片、黏合性差的中型卵圓細胞，細胞質淡嗜伊紅、核卵圓帶核溝或折疊，右上角有小淋巴球聚集；這種類似蘭格漢斯細胞的組織球浸潤但缺少大量嗜伊紅球，需靠 CD1a+/S100+/Langerin− 確認為不定型樹突細胞腫瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-sized histiocytoid cells with moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Oval to reniform nuclei with nuclear grooves/folds and fine chromatin
Inconspicuous to small nucleoli; mild nuclear variation
Cells arranged in loosely cohesive sheets with artefactual cleft-like spaces
Small lymphocyte aggregate at the edge; eosinophils not prominent
61848.describe_en: Section shows a diffuse, sheet-like proliferation of medium-sized histiocytoid cells with moderate amounts of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to reniform nuclei with delicate chromatin, nuclear grooves, and inconspicuous nucleoli. A small aggregate of mature lymphocytes is present at the periphery, and eosinophils are not conspicuous. The morphology is that of a Langerhans-like dendritic cell proliferation; lineage and subtype require immunohistochemistry. With CD1a and S100 positivity and Langerin (CD207) negativity, findings are consistent with indeterminate dendritic cell tumor.

ddx.vs: LCH has similar grooved nuclei but usually an eosinophil-rich background and is Langerin positive, whereas indeterminate cell tumor is Langerin negative.
IDCS cells are spindled to ovoid in whorls, S100+ but CD1a- and Langerin-.
Histiocytic sarcoma shows larger pleomorphic cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and CD68/CD163/PU.1 expression without CD1a.
Melanoma is S100+ but also SOX10/HMB45/Melan-A positive and CD1a negative; carcinoma expresses keratins.

61720.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD123 免疫染色：大量中型腫瘤細胞呈細胞膜及顆粒狀胞質棕色陽性，陽性細胞成片分布於脂肪空隙之間，另夾雜陰性小細胞；廣泛強陽性 CD123 是 BPDCN 的關鍵標記。
features: Numerous intermediate-sized cells with membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD123 staining
Positive cells arranged in confluent sheets and clusters between adipocytes
Interspersed CD123-negative cells with small round blue nuclei
Round to oval tumor nuclei with fine chromatin on counterstain
Staining intensity moderate to strong and relatively uniform within the positive population
61720.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD123 on a bone marrow biopsy shows membranous and granular cytoplasmic positivity in numerous intermediate-sized neoplastic cells arranged in confluent sheets between adipocytes. Interspersed smaller hematopoietic cells are negative. Strong and extensive CD123 expression, together with CD4, CD56 and TCF4 or TCL1, is a key diagnostic feature of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm. Findings support marrow involvement by BPDCN in the appropriate immunophenotypic context.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with CD123 expression
ddx.vs: CD123 is expressed in many AMLs, but usually with weaker or partial staining and accompanying MPO, CD34 or CD117, without TCF4/TCL1 and CD56 co-expression.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with CMML/AML
ddx.vs: These form small CD123+ nodules of mature pDCs that are CD56-negative and have low Ki-67, rather than sheets replacing the marrow.
Mast cells can be CD123-weak but are spindled with CD117/tryptase/CD25 positivity.

61656.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片可見密集排列、胞質豐富且呈粉紅色細顆粒狀的細胞，核圓至腎形、部分核周有淡染區，細胞邊界清楚，正常造血幾近消失，符合 APL 的切片型態。
features: Densely packed cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm
Round to reniform nuclei, some with folded contours and perinuclear clearing
Relatively distinct cell borders
Scattered extravasated red cells
Residual megakaryocyte at periphery; normal maturing elements scant
61656.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a densely cellular infiltrate of cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm, relatively distinct cell borders, and round to reniform nuclei, some with folded contours and perinuclear clearing. Normal maturing hematopoietic elements are scant, with a residual megakaryocyte at the edge of the field, and extravasated red cells are present. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical context; MPO immunostaining and PML::RARA testing are confirmatory.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia shows a full maturation spectrum including metamyelocytes, bands, and segmented neutrophils, not a monotonous promyelocyte population.
Mast cell infiltrates are spindled or ovoid with clear cytoplasm, paratrabecular/perivascular with fibrosis, and are tryptase/CD25-positive.
Blasts in AML with maturation have scanter cytoplasm and lack the dense granular cytoplasm; PML::RARA negative.

61592.recognize_zh: 肝臟浸潤區內有大量細胞質呈顆粒狀棕色 MPO 陽性的髓系細胞，夾雜 MPO 陰性的單核樣細胞，左上肝細胞完全陰性；證實浸潤中含大量顆粒球系成分，符合 JMML 的骨髓單核系混合浸潤。
features: Dense sinusoidal/portal hematopoietic infiltrate in liver
Numerous cells with strong granular cytoplasmic MPO positivity (granulocytic lineage)
Admixed MPO-negative mononuclear cells with oval to folded nuclei (monocytic, erythroid or lymphoid cells)
Hepatocytes at upper left are MPO-negative
Positive cells range from immature to maturing forms, some with segmented nuclei
61592.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for myeloperoxidase on a liver section shows a dense hematopoietic infiltrate in which numerous cells display strong granular cytoplasmic MPO positivity, including maturing forms with segmented nuclei. A substantial population of MPO-negative mononuclear cells with oval to folded nuclei is admixed, and adjacent hepatocytes are negative. The mixture of MPO-positive granulocytic cells and MPO-negative cells supports a myelomonocytic infiltrate rather than a pure monocytic or lymphoid process. Findings are consistent with hepatic involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Also contains MPO+ granulocytes, but includes megakaryocytes and erythroid islands and lacks a CD14+ monocytic predominance.
Infiltrate is largely MPO-negative/weak with CD14/CD163/lysozyme-positive monoblasts.
MPO+ cells are mature neutrophils associated with necrosis or microorganisms, without immature myelomonocytic and erythroid precursors.

61528.recognize_zh: 中央一個多核／多葉核的大細胞，CD15 呈顆粒狀膜與細胞質染色，並在核旁有一團濃染的高基氏體點狀（paranuclear Golgi dot）；周圍小淋巴球均為陰性，符合 Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg 細胞的 CD15 表現型態。
features: Large multinucleated/multilobated cell with abundant cytoplasm among negative small lymphocytes
Granular CD15 staining along the membrane and within the cytoplasm
Dense paranuclear dot-like (Golgi) CD15 accentuation
A second large cell at the right edge shows the same Golgi-pattern positivity
Background lymphocytes and stromal cells are CD15 negative
61528.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD15 highlights scattered large multinucleated cells in a background of negative small lymphocytes. The large cells show granular membranous and cytoplasmic staining with a distinct paranuclear Golgi dot. This membrane-plus-Golgi pattern in large atypical cells supports their identity as Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells. Findings are consistent with classical Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis subtype.

ddx.vs: ALCL is usually CD15 negative with strong uniform CD30 in sheets and expresses T-cell markers, cytotoxic granules, or ALK.
LP cells are CD15 and CD30 negative but CD20, OCT2, and BOB1 positive.
Neutrophils and myeloid cells stain diffusely for CD15 but are small with segmented nuclei and lack Golgi-dot accentuation in a large atypical cell.

61464.recognize_zh: 兩格血片中可見紅血球被吞噬（erythrophagocytosis）：左圖為單核球細胞質內含一顆完整紅血球，右圖為中性球內含紅血球，背景可見部分無中央淡染區的紅血球，此白血球吞噬紅血球的表現是陣發性冷血色素尿症（PCH）的典型血片線索。
features: Left panel: monocyte with blue-gray cytoplasm containing an intact engulfed red cell
Right panel: neutrophil with an ingested red cell within a cytoplasmic vacuole (erythrophagocytosis)
A second neutrophil without inclusions present for comparison (left panel)
Background red cells include some without central pallor (possible spherocytes) and small red cell clusters
No schistocytes or parasites seen; platelets present
61464.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows erythrophagocytosis by leukocytes: a monocyte (left) contains an intact ingested red cell, and a neutrophil (right) contains an engulfed red cell within a cytoplasmic vacuole. The background red cells include occasional forms lacking central pallor, suggestive of spherocytes, with small red cell clusters; no schistocytes or intraerythrocytic parasites are evident. In a patient with acute hemolysis and hemoglobinuria, neutrophil erythrophagocytosis is a characteristic smear clue to paroxysmal cold hemoglobinuria, to be confirmed with a positive Donath-Landsteiner test and a DAT positive for C3.

ddx.vs: CAD shows prominent red cell agglutination at room temperature caused by IgM, while neutrophil erythrophagocytosis is uncommon and the Donath-Landsteiner test is negative.
Warm AIHA features numerous spherocytes with IgG-positive DAT, and erythrophagocytosis by neutrophils is rare.
HLH erythrophagocytosis is by marrow histiocytes with cytopenias and high ferritin, not by circulating neutrophils during acute intravascular hemolysis.
Artifactual phagocytosis appears in old EDTA samples; a freshly made smear with clinical hemolysis supports a true finding.

61400.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中散在數顆中大型母細胞，核質比高、核圓或有凹陷、胞質少量嗜鹼性，伴隨破碎細胞與血小板聚集，提示急性骨髓性白血病的循環母細胞；此放大倍率無法評估 Auer 小體或顆粒。
features: Scattered medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Round to indented or irregular nuclei; chromatin detail and nucleoli limited at this magnification
Occasional smudged/disrupted cells and a platelet aggregate
Dark stain precipitate/debris scattered over the smear (artifact)
Red cells largely normocytic without prominent schistocytes; mature neutrophils scarce in field
61400.describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows scattered circulating medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to indented nuclei and scant basophilic cytoplasm, along with a few disrupted cells and a platelet aggregate. Mature granulocytes are sparse in this field. Dark granular stain precipitate is present as an artifact. Auer rods, granules and nucleolar detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of circulating blasts in acute myeloid leukemia; lineage assignment requires higher-power review, cytochemistry and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts lack Auer rods and are MPO-negative, expressing TdT with B- or T-lineage markers on flow cytometry.
