Leukoerythroblastosis shows immature myeloid cells across maturation stages with nucleated red cells and teardrop cells rather than a predominance of blasts.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and more condensed chromatin than blasts.

61336.recognize_zh: 指標旁單一顆中型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質為一圈淡藍色，細胞核呈深度分葉、花瓣狀／腦迴狀的放射排列（cerebriform），染色質緻密且看不到核仁，是 Sézary 型異常 T 細胞的典型外觀。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cell with a thin rim of pale blue, agranular cytoplasm
Nucleus deeply cleaved into multiple radiating lobes, giving a flower-like cerebriform appearance
Dense, coarsely clumped chromatin without visible nucleoli
Background of normal red cells with scattered stain precipitate and a pointer at left
61336.describe_en: Smear shows a single medium-sized lymphoid cell with a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm and a strikingly convoluted nucleus that is deeply cleaved into multiple radiating lobes, imparting a flower-like cerebriform configuration. The chromatin is dense and nucleoli are not visible. The background red cells show only stain precipitate. In a patient with cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, this morphology is consistent with a Sézary-type cell, and involvement should be quantified by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: The classic flower cell looks similar, so HTLV-1 serology, CD25 expression and clinical features such as hypercalcemia are required to separate them.
Has separate round lobes connected by thin filaments and granular pink cytoplasm, rather than folded lobes in scant blue cytoplasm.
Has only a single notch or indentation and more abundant cytoplasm, without the multilobated cerebriform folding.
Apoptotic cells show round pyknotic fragments with hypereosinophilic cytoplasm rather than an intact lobated nucleus.

61272.recognize_zh: 皮膚真皮內可見中型不成熟細胞沿膠原束之間呈單排或小片浸潤，核卵圓至不規則、染色質細緻，細胞質少量淡染；其間散布許多深染的核碎片凋亡小體（apoptotic bodies），右側仍保存附屬器上皮。這種在膠原間穿插浸潤的母細胞，是白血病皮膚浸潤（leukemia cutis）的樣子。
features: Dermal infiltrate of medium-sized immature cells dissecting between collagen bundles in single files and small sheets, denser toward the right
Oval to irregular, occasionally folded nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale amphophilic cytoplasm
Numerous interspersed apoptotic bodies and karyorrhectic nuclear debris
Adnexal epithelium at the right edge; epidermis not included; no granulomas or vasculitis
61272.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows a diffuse dermal infiltrate of medium-sized mononuclear cells that percolate between collagen bundles in single files and form denser sheets adjacent to an adnexal structure. The cells have oval to irregular nuclei with fine chromatin, small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm, with numerous interspersed apoptotic bodies and karyorrhectic debris. The pattern of interstitial infiltration with blastic cytology is not typical of a reactive dermatitis. Immunohistochemistry (MPO, lysozyme, CD33, CD68, CD117, and cytoplasmic NPM1) is needed for lineage confirmation. In a patient with AML, findings are consistent with leukemia cutis.

ddx.vs: Also presents as a dermal blastic infiltrate, often sparing the epidermis, but is CD4/CD56/CD123/TCF4 positive and MPO/lysozyme negative.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous or systemic large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Cells are larger with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli and express CD20/PAX5 rather than myeloid markers.
The infiltrate consists of immature-appearing MPO-positive myeloid cells with papillary dermal edema and lacks blast-level atypia and a clonal genetic lesion.
Shows cohesive sheets with salt-and-pepper chromatin and nuclear molding and is CK20 dot-positive and CD45-negative.

61208.recognize_zh: PAS 染色下，組織球大空泡內成群的小型圓形酵母體呈洋紅色環狀（壁染色、中心淡），大小一致，符合被 PAS 凸顯的組織漿菌。
features: Clusters of small uniform round yeast forms with magenta PAS-positive walls and paler centers, within large clear histiocyte vacuoles
A few curved, thread-like magenta fragments accompany the yeasts, likely distorted or collapsed walls
Background of foamy/vacuolated histiocytes and mixed hematopoietic cells in marrow
No true septate hyphae are evident
61208.describe_en: PAS stain on the bone marrow biopsy shows vacuolated histiocytes containing clusters of small, uniform, round yeast forms with magenta-staining walls and pale centers; occasional curved thread-like PAS-positive fragments likely represent collapsed walls. The surrounding marrow contains vacuolated histiocytes and hematopoietic cells. Findings are consistent with intracellular Histoplasma capsulatum highlighted by PAS.

ddx.vs: Leishmania is PAS and GMS negative and shows a kinetoplast on H&E/Giemsa.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.

ddx.dx: PAS-positive histiocytes in Whipple disease or glycogen/mucin
ddx.vs: Whipple and storage material produce granular or diffuse cytoplasmic PAS staining without discrete round yeast walls.

61144.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖：紅色族群在 CD117 vs CD25 圖上呈 CD117 強陽性且 CD25 陽性（占 18%），在 CD25 vs CD2 圖上也表現 CD2，即 CD117bright/CD25+/CD2+ 的異常肥大細胞表型。
features: Left plot (SSC vs CD45): red-gated events show intermediate-to-high side scatter and CD45 positivity overlapping the granulocyte region
Middle plot (CD117 vs CD25): a discrete CD117-bright population coexpressing CD25 accounts for 18% of events
Right plot (CD25 vs CD2): the same red population shows CD2 expression (circled) above the negative blue background
Blue background events are CD117-negative, CD25-negative, CD2-negative
Immunophenotype CD117bright/CD25+/CD2+ indicates aberrant (neoplastic) mast cells
61144.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis displays three dot plots. Gated red events have intermediate to high side scatter with CD45 expression, and on the CD117 versus CD25 plot form a distinct CD117-bright population coexpressing CD25 that represents 18% of analyzed events. The same population expresses CD2 on the CD25 versus CD2 plot, whereas background events are negative for all three markers. Aberrant CD25 and CD2 expression on CD117-bright cells fulfills a minor WHO criterion for systemic mastocytosis, and the high proportion of mast cells is consistent with mast cell leukemia in the appropriate morphologic context.

ddx.vs: Normal mast cells are CD117-bright but CD25-negative and CD2-negative and usually constitute <0.1% of marrow events.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with CD117 expression
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are CD117 dim-to-moderate with low side scatter and CD34/HLA-DR expression, not CD117-bright with high side scatter.

ddx.dx: CD25+ T-cell or hairy cell leukemia populations
ddx.vs: These CD25+ cells are CD117-negative and express CD3 or CD19/CD103/CD11c respectively.

61080.recognize_zh: 低倍下腦組織旁瀰漫的淋巴樣浸潤並以多個血管為中心呈同心圓袖套狀聚集（angiocentric），高倍為成片大型、核呈泡狀且有核仁的中心母細胞/免疫母細胞樣細胞，並有核分裂與凋亡碎片。
features: Low power (1a): diffuse cellular infiltrate beneath/adjacent to brain parenchyma with multiple vessels surrounded by concentric cuffs of tumor cells
Angiocentric growth (1c): dense perivascular collar of atypical lymphoid cells infiltrating the vessel wall
Medium power (1b): diffuse sheets of large discohesive cells with scattered apoptotic bodies
High power (1d): large cells (≥2x small lymphocyte nucleus) with vesicular chromatin, irregular nuclear contours and one or more nucleoli; frequent mitoses
Scant cytoplasm; admixed small reactive lymphocytes are few
61080.describe_en: Sections of brain show a diffuse, densely cellular infiltrate with prominent angiocentric growth, in which atypical lymphoid cells form concentric perivascular cuffs and infiltrate vessel walls. At higher power the infiltrate consists of sheets of large lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, irregular nuclear contours, prominent nucleoli, frequent mitoses and apoptotic bodies. There is no glial fibrillary background or necrosis-rimming palisade evident in these fields. Findings are consistent with primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the CNS, to be confirmed by CD20/PAX5 immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Glioblastoma has fibrillary GFAP+ astrocytic cells with palisading necrosis and microvascular proliferation rather than discohesive large lymphoid cells cuffing vessels.
Metastases are cohesive with sharp borders and express keratin or melanocytic markers, not CD45/CD20.
These show foamy macrophages and small perivascular T cells without sheets of large atypical B cells; steroid pretreatment can mimic this.
These show polymorphous infiltrates with EBER-positive large B cells, often in immunosuppressed patients.

61016.recognize_zh: 大小正常、未變大的紅血球內有多個纖細的小環狀體（ring form），部分有兩個染色質點（雙點，headphone 狀）、一顆紅血球內有兩個環（多重感染），也有貼在細胞邊緣的附著型（appliqué），且看不到較成熟的滋養體或裂殖體，符合惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）。
features: Multiple delicate, small ring forms occupying about one-fifth of the red cell diameter
Double chromatin dots ('headphone' rings) in several rings (e.g., lower right)
Multiply infected red cell containing two rings (center)
Peripheral accolé/appliqué forms flattened against the red cell membrane
Infected red cells are normal in size without Schüffner stippling; no trophozoites, schizonts or gametocytes seen
Occasional platelets in the background
61016.describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows numerous intraerythrocytic parasites present exclusively as small, delicate ring forms. Several rings have double chromatin dots, one red cell harbors two rings, and appliqué forms are seen at the red cell margin. Infected red cells are not enlarged and lack Schüffner dots, and no mature trophozoites or schizonts are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum infection; parasitemia should be quantified and a search for banana-shaped gametocytes performed.

ddx.vs: Infected cells are enlarged with Schüffner stippling and all stages (amoeboid trophozoites, schizonts) are present in the blood.
Show band-form trophozoites and schizonts with pigment in blood; P. knowlesi early rings can mimic falciparum, requiring PCR and travel history to Southeast Asia.
Babesia rings are pleomorphic, lack hemozoin pigment and gametocytes, and may form tetrad 'Maltese cross' figures, with a tick-exposure history rather than tropical travel.
Overlying platelets are granular without a blue cytoplasmic ring and a discrete red chromatin dot.

60952.recognize_zh: 影像顯示腰椎與肋骨多處骨病灶（箭頭），骨髓切片為成片的漿細胞樣細胞（偏心核、豐富細胞質），免疫染色呈強烈膜染色，蛋白電泳在 γ 區有小尖峰（箭頭），整體符合漿細胞骨髓瘤，出現在兒童實屬罕見。
features: Imaging: sagittal spine MRI, coronal CT and axial cross-sectional images with arrows marking focal bone lesions
Biopsy H&E: diffuse sheets of monotonous plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
IHC (two panels): strong diffuse membranous staining of the infiltrate, consistent with plasma-cell markers such as CD138/CD38
Additional stain panel showing sheet-like infiltrate with nuclear/cytoplasmic highlighting (specific stain not labeled)
Densitometric electrophoresis trace with a small peak in the gamma region (arrow), consistent with an M-protein
60952.describe_en: Radiologic images show focal lesions in the lumbar spine, ribs and a cross-sectioned bone (arrows). The bone marrow/lesional biopsy shows diffuse sheets of monotonous plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and moderate cytoplasm, without intervening normal hematopoiesis. Immunohistochemical stains show strong, diffuse membranous positivity of the infiltrate, and an additional stain highlights the sheet-like population. Serum protein electrophoresis densitometry demonstrates a small monoclonal peak in the gamma region. Image legends are not provided, so specific antibodies cannot be confirmed; in context, findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma in a pediatric patient.

ddx.vs: Plasmacytoma is a single lesion without clonal marrow plasmacytosis elsewhere, whereas multiple skeletal lesions are shown here.
Shows larger immunoblastic cells with high Ki-67, often EBER-positive and MYC-rearranged, usually in immunodeficient patients and without CRAB-type skeletal disease.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., Ewing sarcoma, neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: These are CD138/light-chain negative with CD99/NKX2-2 or PHOX2B expression and lack an M-protein.
Causes lytic bone lesions in children but consists of grooved CD1a+/langerin+ cells with eosinophils rather than plasma cells.

60952.stain: H&E; IHC (plasma cell markers, unlabeled); MRI/CT; SPEP

60888.recognize_zh: Myogenin 免疫染色下，成片的圓形至卵圓形腫瘤細胞大多數呈現棕色細胞核陽性，並被纖維血管間隔分成巢狀，瀰漫強的核陽性支持肺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤。
features: Nests and sheets of crowded round to oval tumor cells separated by pale fibrovascular septa
Nuclear myogenin immunoreactivity in the majority of tumor cells, varying from moderate to strong
Minor subset of nuclei negative (blue hematoxylin counterstain)
Scant cytoplasm with high N:C ratio; mild background cytoplasmic blush
No staining of stromal cells in the septa
60888.describe_en: Myogenin immunohistochemistry shows nests and sheets of small round tumor cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio separated by fibrovascular septa. The majority of tumor cell nuclei show moderate to strong nuclear myogenin staining, with a minor negative subset; stromal cells are negative. Diffuse nuclear myogenin expression confirms skeletal muscle differentiation and is consistent with alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma; FOXO1 rearrangement testing can confirm the subtype.

ddx.vs: Embryonal RMS usually shows only patchy/focal myogenin, whereas diffuse strong nuclear myogenin in most cells favors the alveolar, FOXO1 fusion-positive type.
Ewing sarcoma is myogenin negative with membranous CD99 and nuclear NKX2.2 positivity.
Neuroblastoma is myogenin negative and expresses PHOX2B, synaptophysin and chromogranin.
Lymphoblasts show nuclear TdT rather than myogenin and express CD45 plus B- or T-cell markers.

60824.recognize_zh: Oct-2 為核染色：大型、核型不規則的腫瘤細胞呈強而均勻的棕色核陽性，周圍小細胞多為陰性；大細胞保留 B 細胞轉錄因子，與典型何杰金 RS 細胞常失去 Oct-2 不同，支持灰區淋巴瘤。
features: Strong nuclear Oct-2 staining in numerous large cells with irregular, lobated or folded nuclei
Positive cells arranged in dense clusters and bands
Uniform staining intensity across the large cell population
Background small lymphocytes and stromal/histiocytic nuclei largely negative (blue hematoxylin counterstain)
60824.describe_en: Oct-2 immunohistochemistry shows strong, uniform nuclear staining in the large atypical cells, which have irregular lobated nuclei and are arranged in clusters and bands, whereas the background small cells and stromal nuclei are negative. Preservation of this B-cell transcription factor in Hodgkin-like large cells argues against classic Hodgkin lymphoma and, together with CD15 positivity and variable CD20, supports a B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HRS cells show absent or weak Oct-2 and/or BOB.1 expression in most cases, unlike the strong uniform nuclear staining here.
LP cells are also strongly Oct-2+ but are CD15/CD30-negative and embedded in follicular dendritic cell meshworks with T-cell rosettes.
PMBL is Oct-2 positive as well but consists of monotonous CD20-strong, CD23+/MAL+ cells without CD15 expression.

60632.recognize_zh: 周邊血中血小板數目增多、大小不一，紅血球間散見棘狀／刺狀紅血球（acanthocytes）與少數紅血球內小顆深色點狀包涵體（Howell-Jolly bodies），這組合提示脾功能低下（functional hyposplenism）造成的反應性血小板增多。
features: Increased numbers of platelets with variation in size, including some larger forms
Scattered acanthocytes/spiculated red cells with irregularly spaced projections
Occasional red cells with small, round, dense basophilic inclusions consistent with Howell-Jolly bodies
Target cells and red cells with irregular central pallor
Mature lymphocyte and white cells without significant morphologic abnormality
60632.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased platelets with anisocytosis. The red cells show scattered acanthocytes and occasional target cells, and rare erythrocytes contain small dense basophilic inclusions consistent with Howell-Jolly bodies. Leukocytes present show no significant abnormality. Because the spleen normally removes these red cell inclusions and abnormal membranes, this combination supports reduced splenic function. Findings are consistent with hyposplenism (functional or post-splenectomy) with reactive thrombocytosis; clinical correlation for celiac disease, sickle cell disease or splenic infarction is recommended.

ddx.vs: ET shows thrombocytosis with large platelets but lacks Howell-Jolly bodies and acanthocytes unless splenic infarction has occurred; JAK2/CALR/MPL testing separates them.

ddx.dx: Spur cell anemia of liver disease
ddx.vs: Spur cell anemia has numerous acanthocytes with hemolysis but no Howell-Jolly bodies or thrombocytosis.
Pappenheimer bodies are multiple fine peripheral granules that are Prussian blue-positive, whereas Howell-Jolly bodies are single round DNA remnants.
An overlying platelet is granular with a halo and lies in a different focal plane, unlike a dense round intraerythrocytic Howell-Jolly body.

60696.recognize_zh: 周邊血紅血球排列擁擠（血液濃縮），可見嗜中性球增多但無毒性顆粒、少量髓細胞、血小板稀少，並有細胞質深藍的免疫母細胞樣淋巴球（插圖）；在急性非心因性肺水腫病人，這組抹片特徵強烈提示漢他病毒心肺症候群。
features: Crowded, closely packed red cells even in the thin area, reflecting hemoconcentration
Increased neutrophils, including bands, without toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or vacuolation
Occasional immature granulocyte (myelocyte) consistent with left shift
Large immunoblastic lymphocytes with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round nuclei, open chromatin and a clear perinuclear zone (inset)
Few platelets visible (thrombocytopenia); several smudged/disrupted leukocytes at the lower field
60696.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows densely packed red cells consistent with hemoconcentration and a neutrophilic leukocytosis with bands and occasional myelocytes but no toxic granulation. There are increased large immunoblastic lymphocytes with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round nuclei and relatively open chromatin, and platelets are sparse. No blasts or intracellular organisms are identified. In the context of acute noncardiogenic pulmonary edema, this constellation of neutrophilia without toxic change, left shift, immunoblasts, thrombocytopenia and hemoconcentration is highly suggestive of hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome, confirmed here by serology and PCR.

ddx.vs: Sepsis usually shows toxic granulation, Döhle bodies and vacuolated neutrophils, and lacks marked hemoconcentration with numerous immunoblasts.

ddx.dx: Infectious mononucleosis or other viral reactive lymphocytosis
ddx.vs: EBV/CMV produce abundant Downey-type reactive lymphocytes hugging red cells, without neutrophilia, left shift and hemoconcentration.
Leukemic blasts have fine chromatin and nucleoli with scant cytoplasm and form a monotonous population, unlike these plasmacytoid immunoblasts with mature neutrophils.
Dengue also causes thrombocytopenia, hemoconcentration and reactive lymphocytes but typically leukopenia rather than neutrophilic leukocytosis, and is separated by travel history and serology.

60440.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨小樑之間的骨髓大多被脂肪取代，造血細胞只在脂肪細胞間形成細網狀、片狀分布，左上區域幾乎全為脂肪與出血；兒童全血球減少合併這種低細胞性、不均勻的造血，是兒童難治性血球減少症常見的切片樣貌。
features: Hypocellular marrow for age with fat cells occupying most of the intertrabecular space
Patchy distribution: residual hematopoiesis in thin interstitial cords, with near-empty fatty/hemorrhagic areas at the upper left
Residual hematopoietic cells include clusters of dark round erythroid precursors and scattered myeloid cells
Few megakaryocytes identified at this magnification
Bony trabeculae unremarkable; no fibrosis, granulomas, or abnormal infiltrate
60440.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, low-medium power) shows an intertrabecular space largely replaced by adipose tissue. Residual hematopoiesis is patchy, forming thin interstitial cords and small foci composed mainly of erythroid precursors with admixed myeloid cells and rare megakaryocytes. There is no increase in blasts, fibrosis, granulomas or infiltrative process. The marrow is hypocellular for an 8-year-old; with pancytopenia, the findings are consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood, pending cytogenetic and constitutional work-up.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows diffuse aplasia with near-absent megakaryocytes and lacks the scattered erythroid islands seen in refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.dx: Fanconi anemia or other inherited marrow failure
ddx.vs: Histology overlaps; chromosome breakage studies and germline genetic testing are required.
Not separable morphologically; flow cytometry for GPI-anchored proteins (FLAER, CD59) identifies PNH clones.

60376.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑之間幾乎沒有脂肪空泡，骨髓腔被均一的細胞浸潤完全填滿（細胞量近 100%），提示 B-ALL 復發造成的骨髓瀰漫性取代；低倍下無法判斷細胞種類。
features: Adequate core with multiple bony trabeculae
Markedly hypercellular marrow approaching 100% cellularity with near-total loss of fat spaces
Diffuse, monotonous infiltrate filling intertrabecular spaces
No discernible normal trilineage architecture or megakaryocyte clusters at this power
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
60376.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows multiple bony trabeculae with intervening marrow spaces that are nearly 100% cellular, with almost complete loss of fat. The marrow is diffusely replaced by a monotonous-appearing infiltrate without recognizable normal hematopoietic architecture. Cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification, but in the context of the accompanying high-power and immunohistochemical findings, the appearance is consistent with diffuse marrow involvement by relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Also produces a packed marrow; distinguished at high power and by immunophenotype (MPO/CD117 vs CD79a/PAX5/TdT).
MPNs retain trilineage maturation with prominent, often clustered megakaryocytes rather than a monotonous infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by lymphoma (e.g., Burkitt or DLBCL)
ddx.vs: Requires high-power cytology and TdT/CD34 negativity with mature B-cell markers to separate from lymphoblastic leukemia.

60184.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片下方有一個雙核的嗜鹼性紅母細胞，右上有一個細胞質淡染、含三個相連圓核的多核紅血球系前驅細胞，中央細胞則見核分葉不規則，皆為明顯的紅血球系發育異常（dyserythropoiesis）。
features: Large binucleated early erythroblast with deeply basophilic cytoplasm (bottom)
Late erythroid precursor with three connected round nuclear fragments in pale polychromatic cytoplasm
Precursor with irregular, lobulated dense nucleus suggesting nuclear budding or abnormal mitosis
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony in polychromatic erythroblasts with clumped chromatin
Background with scattered smudged cells and poikilocytic red cells
60184.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid precursors with marked dysplastic features. A large binucleated basophilic erythroblast is present, along with a late precursor containing three connected round nuclear fragments and another cell with an irregular, lobulated nucleus suggestive of nuclear budding or an abnormal mitosis. Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony is evident. These dyserythropoietic changes support a myelodysplastic syndrome, classified as MDS with excess blasts based on the blast count.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic erythroid precursors show uniformly open, finely stippled chromatin with giant myeloid forms and respond to B12/folate replacement.
CDA II shows binucleated late normoblasts as an isolated, lifelong finding with positive acidified-serum test and no increased blasts.
History of alcohol, chemotherapy or heavy metal exposure and absence of clonal abnormalities favor a secondary cause.

60120.recognize_zh: 周邊血液可見三顆芽細胞，其中兩顆併排、核形不規則或有凹陷、染色質細緻、細胞質少而淡藍無顆粒，背景血小板稀少並有淚滴狀紅血球；6 歲女童貧血、血小板低加上此型態，須懷疑急性淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Three circulating blasts, small to medium in size (about 1.5–2 times a red cell)
High N:C ratio with irregular, focally indented nuclear contours
Fine chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods
Background mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional teardrop cells; platelets reduced
60120.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional teardrop cells and decreased platelets. Three blasts are present in this field; they are small to medium-sized with a high N:C ratio, irregular to indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular pale blue cytoplasm. No Auer rods or granules are seen. In a 6-year-old with anemia and thrombocytopenia, findings are suggestive of acute lymphoblastic leukemia, confirmed as T-lineage by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical and more common in children; flow cytometry (CD19 vs cytoplasmic CD3) is required.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and more condensed chromatin, without anemia and thrombocytopenia of marrow failure.
Myeloblasts often show granules or Auer rods and more cytoplasm; MPO and myeloid antigens separate them.

60056.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片觸片（touch prep）在稀釋血液背景中可見多顆中型母細胞：核佔滿細胞、染色質細緻、細胞質僅剩一圈藍色邊緣且無顆粒，形狀偏不規則；這些形態只能判定為母細胞，需要流式與染色體（此例 Ph+ p190）確認為 B-ALL。
features: Frequent intermediate-sized blasts with very high N:C ratio
Round to irregular/angular nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin; nucleoli indistinct
Scant rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods
Hemodilute background with abundant red cells and few mature granulocytes
Preparation artifact: clear vacuole-like spaces and some crushed/distorted cells limit cytologic detail
60056.describe_en: Touch imprint of the bone marrow core biopsy, performed because the aspirate was hemodilute, shows frequent intermediate-sized blasts in a background of red cells. The blasts have very high N:C ratio, round to irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and indistinct nucleoli, and a scant rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen. Mature granulocytes and erythroid precursors are sparse, and preparation artifact limits fine cytologic evaluation. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia; lineage requires immunophenotyping, and together with the B-lymphoblast phenotype and the Philadelphia chromosome (p190 BCR::ABL1), support B-lymphoblastic leukemia with BCR::ABL1 fusion.

ddx.vs: Agranular myeloblasts can look identical on touch preps; MPO cytochemistry or flow cytometry showing CD117/CD33/MPO is needed to separate them.
Shares Ph positivity but usually carries p210, with evidence of a preceding chronic phase such as basophilia and granulocytic hyperplasia.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are TdT-negative mature B cells with MYC rearrangement.
Mature lymphocytes are smaller with condensed clumped chromatin, unlike the fine chromatin and larger size of these blasts.

17944.recognize_zh: 臉部（鼻樑、兩頰、上唇周圍）與手背等日曬處可見紅斑、細小線狀/凹陷性淺疤與皮膚粗厚，沒有水疱，符合紅血球生成性原紫質症（erythropoietic protoporphyria）慢性光敏感的皮膚變化。
features: Clinical photographs, not a microscopic image
Panel A: erythema over the nose and cheeks with fine linear and shallow pitted scars on the face and perioral skin
Panel B: dorsal hand with thickened, slightly waxy skin and small scattered crusts/scars over knuckles and fingers
No bullae or hypertrichosis evident
Lesions confined to sun-exposed sites
17944.describe_en: Clinical photographs (Balwani and Desnick, Hematology 2012) show the face with erythema over the nose and cheeks and fine linear and shallow pitted scars around the nose and upper lip, and the dorsal hand with thickened skin and small scattered crusts over sun-exposed areas. Bullae are not seen. These chronic changes follow repeated painful acute phototoxic reactions. Findings are consistent with erythropoietic protoporphyria; diagnosis is confirmed by markedly elevated erythrocyte free (metal-free) protoporphyrin.

ddx.vs: PCT shows vesicles, bullae, skin fragility and hypertrichosis with elevated urine uroporphyrin, whereas EPP lacks blisters and has normal urine porphyrins.
Clinical findings are identical; XLP has a higher proportion of zinc protoporphyrin and ALAS2 gain-of-function mutation.
PMLE produces delayed pruritic papules or plaques rather than immediate burning pain, and erythrocyte protoporphyrin is normal.
Hydroa vacciniforme forms vesicles that heal with varioliform scars and is associated with EBV, with normal protoporphyrin levels.

12952.recognize_zh: 厚片（左）滿布大量紫色染色質點狀的瘧原蟲；薄片（右）許多紅血球內有細緻的環狀體（ring form），部分有雙染色質點或一顆紅血球多重感染，紅血球大小未變大，且看不到成熟滋養體或裂殖體，符合惡性瘧原蟲（Plasmodium falciparum）高寄生率感染。
features: Thin film: numerous delicate ring forms within normal-sized red cells, some with double chromatin dots
Multiply infected red cells and marginal (appliqué) forms
Absence of mature trophozoites and schizonts in the circulating red cells
Infected red cells not enlarged, without Schüffner dots
Thick film: dense field of small ring-stage parasites with dot-like chromatin and a leukocyte
12952.describe_en: Giemsa-stained thick and thin blood films are shown. The thick film shows a very dense population of small ring-stage parasites relative to the few leukocytes. The thin film shows a high proportion of erythrocytes containing delicate ring forms, including double chromatin dots, appliqué forms, and multiply infected cells, within red cells of normal size without stippling. Mature trophozoites, schizonts, and gametocytes are not identified. Findings are consistent with hyperparasitemic Plasmodium falciparum infection; parasitemia should be quantified, and the ring-only picture reflects sequestration of maturing stages in the microvasculature.

ddx.vs: Vivax and ovale infect enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots and show all stages including amoeboid trophozoites and schizonts in peripheral blood.
Knowlesi and malariae show band-form trophozoites and circulating schizonts, and knowlesi requires PCR for confirmation.
Babesia forms pleomorphic rings and tetrad (Maltese cross) forms without hemozoin pigment or gametocytes, with travel/tick exposure history.

ddx.dx: Platelets or stain precipitate overlying red cells
ddx.vs: Overlying platelets lack a cytoplasmic ring with a distinct chromatin dot and lie in a different focal plane.

12696.recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓切片中有多個由類上皮組織球（epithelioid histiocytes）緊密聚集而成的肉芽腫，其中含多核巨細胞，未見中央乾酪樣壞死；B、C 特殊染色顯示肉芽腫周圍網狀纖維與膠原纖維增加，符合類肉瘤病（sarcoidosis）的非乾酪性肉芽腫。
features: A: well-formed, confluent granulomas of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated nuclei
A: multinucleated giant cell within a granuloma; no central caseous necrosis
A: rim of lymphocytes and adjacent residual marrow with fat
B: silver-type stain outlining granulomas with a dense surrounding fibrillary network
C: trichrome stain showing blue collagen fibrosis around granulomas next to a bony trabecula
No organisms or atypical lymphoid cells evident at this resolution
12696.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (H&E) shows multiple well-formed, partly confluent granulomas composed of epithelioid histiocytes with a multinucleated giant cell and a peripheral lymphocytic rim, without caseous necrosis. A reticulin-type silver stain outlines the granulomas with increased surrounding fibers, and a trichrome stain shows associated collagen fibrosis adjacent to bony trabeculae. Findings are consistent with noncaseating granulomatous inflammation of the marrow; sarcoidosis is a diagnosis of exclusion, so special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi, cultures, and evaluation for lymphoma and drug exposure should be completed.

ddx.vs: TB granulomas often show caseous necrosis and acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain or positive cultures.
Fungal granulomas contain yeasts demonstrable with GMS or PAS stains, often in immunocompromised hosts.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin lymphoma or T-cell lymphoma with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: Lymphoma-associated granulomas harbor CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin cells or atypical lymphoid infiltrates on IHC.
Lipogranulomas are small, incidental collections of histiocytes around fat vacuoles without confluent epithelioid granulomas or fibrosis.

7576.recognize_zh: 中央大型巨噬細胞的泡沫狀細胞質裡吞了一顆完整的有核細胞（hemophagocytosis），周圍散布許多細小、橢圓形、帶一個核點的蟲體（利什曼原蟲 amastigote），兩者同時出現。
features: Large macrophage with abundant foamy, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Intact phagocytosed nucleated cell (small round dark nucleus with rim of cytoplasm) within the macrophage cytoplasm
Numerous small (2 to 4 um) oval extracellular bodies around the macrophage, each with a dark nucleus, consistent with amastigotes; kinetoplasts are difficult to resolve at this focus
Second macrophage at left with vacuolated magenta-staining cytoplasm
Background of crushed red cells in a bone marrow aspirate
7576.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant foamy cytoplasm that has engulfed an intact nucleated cell, indicating hemophagocytosis. Numerous small oval organisms with a single dark nucleus are scattered at the periphery of the macrophage, most likely released from ruptured histiocytes; the rod-shaped kinetoplast is not clearly resolved in this image. Findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis accompanied by secondary hemophagocytosis, which should prompt evaluation for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis and confirmation by Leishmania PCR, culture or serology.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a clear halo and a crescentic nucleus but lack a kinetoplast, and stain with GMS and PAS.

ddx.dx: Primary or other secondary HLH without infection
ddx.vs: Hemophagocytosis alone is nonspecific; the presence of kinetoplast-bearing amastigotes identifies Leishmania as the trigger.
Toxoplasma organisms are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and no kinetoplast.
Platelets are anucleate with fine granules, whereas amastigotes show a discrete nucleus and a separate kinetoplast.

5912.recognize_zh: 上方細胞細胞質內一束交錯的 Auer 小體（faggot cell），左下細胞呈雙葉「蝴蝶狀」核、細胞質充滿粗顆粒，這兩項是急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）的關鍵線索。
features: Large abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed (butterfly) or folded nuclei
Moderate N:C ratio with nuclear contours obscured by dense granulation
Cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules
Faggot cell (upper center) containing a bundle of crisscrossing Auer rods
Irregular cell borders with clear peripheral cytoplasm in some cells; background normocytic red cells
5912.describe_en: Smear shows several large abnormal promyelocytes among red cells. The cells have folded to bilobed (butterfly-like) nuclei and abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules; one cell contains a bundle of Auer rods (faggot cell). Mature neutrophils are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular type; confirm PML::RARA by FISH or RT-PCR and assess for DIC.

ddx.vs: The microgranular variant shares bilobed nuclei but has sparse or dust-like granules and few Auer rods, whereas these cells are heavily granulated.
AML with maturation shows round-nucleated blasts with occasional single Auer rods plus maturing neutrophils, without hypergranular bilobed promyelocytes.
Promonocytes have folded nuclei but fine lacy chromatin, grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and nonspecific esterase positivity, and lack Auer rod bundles.

3672.recognize_zh: 床邊前後位（AP portable）胸部 X 光顯示雙側瀰漫、以肺門周圍及中下肺野為主的肺泡浸潤影，心臟影未見明顯擴大，配合輸血後 6 小時內發生的急性缺氧可考慮 TRALI。
features: Portable AP semi-erect chest radiograph
Bilateral diffuse airspace opacities, most prominent in perihilar and mid-to-lower zones
Cardiac silhouette not grossly enlarged (limited by AP projection)
No large pleural effusion evident; costophrenic angles partly obscured
Support/monitoring lines overlie the chest
3672.describe_en: Portable AP semi-erect chest radiograph shows bilateral, diffuse, patchy-to-confluent airspace opacities predominantly in the perihilar and lower lung zones. The cardiac silhouette does not appear markedly enlarged, although AP technique limits assessment, and no large pleural effusion is evident. In the setting of acute hypoxemia within 6 hours of transfusion, this pattern of noncardiogenic pulmonary edema is consistent with transfusion-related acute lung injury; the radiograph itself is nonspecific and requires clinical correlation.

ddx.vs: TACO shows hydrostatic features such as cardiomegaly, vascular redistribution, effusions, elevated BNP and response to diuretics, whereas TRALI is noncardiogenic with normal filling pressures.
Radiographically identical; TRALI is defined by temporal onset within 6 hours of transfusion without another ARDS risk factor.
Pneumonia evolves with fever and infectious markers and does not typically resolve within 48-96 hours as TRALI often does.
Suggested by falling hemoglobin, hemoptysis and hemosiderin-laden macrophages on BAL rather than a transfusion time link.

1368.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片整個視野幾乎看不到正常大小的血小板，中央只有一顆接近紅血球大小、紫色顆粒狀的巨大血小板（giant platelet），紅血球與白血球型態正常；血小板稀少但體積大，是 ITP 周邊破壞、骨髓代償的血片表現。
features: Marked paucity of platelets across the field
One large platelet near the center, approaching red cell size, with purple granular cytoplasm and no nucleus
Red cells normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes or spherocytes
No platelet clumps visible
No abnormal white cells in this field
1368.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked thrombocytopenia with only a single large (giant) platelet, approaching the size of a red cell, in this field. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes, and no platelet clumps are identified. White cells are not represented in this field. Findings of isolated thrombocytopenia with large platelets are consistent with increased platelet turnover, as seen in immune thrombocytopenia, which remains a diagnosis of exclusion.

ddx.vs: Most platelets are uniformly giant, often with Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions in MYH9 disease, and there is lifelong history without response to ITP therapy.
Thrombocytopenia is accompanied by schistocytes and hemolysis, which are absent here.
Platelet clumps or satellitism are visible at the feathered edge and the count normalizes in citrate.

2776.recognize_zh: 整片小至中型腫瘤細胞彌漫分佈，核卵圓、細胞質稀少、細胞間黏著性差，背景為大片嗜伊紅性壞死與出血並散佈核碎片（karyorrhexis），沒有神經纖維基質，符合未分化型神經母細胞瘤；保存不佳限制了細節判讀。
features: Diffuse population of small to medium-sized tumor cells with oval, pale-staining nuclei
Scant cytoplasm and poor cellular cohesion
Extensive eosinophilic necrotic/hemorrhagic background with abundant red cells
Scattered pyknotic and karyorrhectic nuclear debris
No neuropil or rosettes identified; tissue preservation is suboptimal
2776.describe_en: H&E section shows a diffuse population of small to medium-sized tumor cells with oval, pale nuclei and scant cytoplasm set in an extensive eosinophilic, necrotic and hemorrhagic background with scattered karyorrhectic debris. Neuropil, Homer Wright rosettes and ganglionic differentiation are not identified, and suboptimal preservation limits nuclear detail. The morphology is that of a poorly differentiated small round cell malignancy with necrosis. In the given context, findings are consistent with undifferentiated metastatic neuroblastoma, which requires immunohistochemical confirmation (PHOX2B, synaptophysin, chromogranin).

ddx.vs: Ewing sarcoma is CD99 membranous and NKX2.2-positive with an EWSR1 fusion and lacks PHOX2B.
Lymphoma cells are CD45-positive with B- or T-lineage markers (and TdT in lymphoblastic), and Burkitt shows a starry-sky pattern with MYC rearrangement.
Rhabdomyosarcoma expresses desmin and myogenin/MyoD1.

2712.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中大片緊密排列的大型細胞，細胞質豐富、淡灰粉紅色帶細條紋如「皺摺衛生紙」（wrinkled tissue paper），核小、圓形且偏心，左上角殘留造血細胞，是典型高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cells）成片浸潤。
features: Sheets of large polygonal histiocytes with abundant pale gray-pink cytoplasm
Cytoplasm with fine fibrillary, striated texture (wrinkled tissue paper appearance)
Small round to oval eccentric nuclei with fine chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
Distinct cell borders forming a mosaic pattern
Residual hematopoietic cells, including erythroid precursors, at the upper left
2712.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows effacement of much of the marrow by sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale gray-pink, finely fibrillary cytoplasm and small, round, eccentric nuclei. Cell borders are distinct, producing a mosaic arrangement. Residual hematopoietic elements are confined to the periphery at the upper left. No atypical mitoses or malignant cells are identified. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow infiltration by Gaucher cells in Gaucher disease.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are usually scattered rather than forming sheets and accompany a background neoplasm or hemolytic disorder with normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
MAC-laden histiocytes can have striated pale cytoplasm but contain numerous acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Niemann-Pick cells show foamy, finely vacuolated cytoplasm rather than fibrillary cytoplasm.
Crystal-storing histiocytes contain eosinophilic crystalline immunoglobulin inclusions and are associated with a light chain-restricted plasma cell or B-cell neoplasm.

1176.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸液滿是大小一致、核圓、染色質細緻的母細胞，僅零星散在帶粗顆粒的細胞，幾乎看不到分葉核或桿狀核顆粒球；母細胞壓倒性地多且缺乏成熟，符合無成熟的 AML。
features: Sheets of intermediate-sized blasts dominating the field
High N:C ratio, round nuclei with fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Most blasts agranular; scattered cells contain coarse azurophilic granules
Near absence of maturing myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Few erythroid precursors; background red cells without other notable features
1176.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and composed of sheets of intermediate-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round nuclei, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm. Most blasts are agranular, although a minority of cells contain coarse azurophilic granules. Maturing granulocytic forms beyond the promyelocyte stage are virtually absent, and erythroid and megakaryocytic elements are markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia without maturation; MPO cytochemistry or flow cytometry is needed to confirm myeloid lineage.

ddx.vs: Requires >=10% maturing granulocytic cells, which are not seen in this blast-dominated field.
APL cells are hypergranular with bilobed or folded nuclei and Auer rod bundles, whereas most cells here are round-nucleated agranular blasts.
The granulated subset favors myeloid lineage, but agranular blasts cannot be separated from lymphoblasts without MPO and flow cytometry.

1240.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下骨小樑之間幾乎 100% 被單調的未成熟細胞填滿，脂肪消失、正常三系造血的混合樣貌不見；這張圖能看出白血病浸潤，但放大倍率不足以判斷顆粒球成熟程度。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) with loss of fat between bony trabeculae
Diffuse sheets of intermediate-sized immature cells with pale to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Effacement of normal trilineage architecture; megakaryocytes not readily identified
Intact lamellar bony trabeculae without osteosclerosis
Cytologic detail (nucleoli, granules, maturing forms) not resolvable at this low magnification
1240.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow, approaching 100% cellularity, with near-complete loss of adipocytes. The intertrabecular spaces are diffusely replaced by sheets of intermediate-sized immature-appearing cells, with effacement of the normal trilineage hematopoietic pattern and inconspicuous megakaryocytes. Bony trabeculae appear unremarkable. The low magnification does not allow assessment of granulocytic maturation, so correlation with the aspirate differential is required; in that context the findings are consistent with involvement by acute myeloid leukemia, reported as AML with maturation.

ddx.vs: Cannot be separated on this low-power biopsy; the aspirate differential showing <10% versus >=10% maturing granulocytes decides.
Also produces a packed marrow, so lineage requires MPO/CD34/TdT immunostains or flow cytometry.
MDS retains trilineage hematopoiesis with dysplastic megakaryocytes and fewer than 20% blasts, rather than diffuse sheets of immature cells.

1304.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，一個大型淋巴聚集幾乎全部呈強陽性棕色（膜性），周圍造血細胞陰性，形態與分布符合 B 細胞標記（多為 CD20）標出以 B 細胞為主的濾泡/生發中心。
features: Large lymphoid aggregate with dense, strong brown membranous staining of the majority of cells
Staining is sharply confined to the aggregate; surrounding hematopoietic cells are negative
Few scattered positive cells in the interstitium
Small central vessel within the positive aggregate
Adjacent bone trabecula (right) shows no paratrabecular positive infiltrate
1304.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostain shows a large intertrabecular lymphoid aggregate in which most cells are strongly positive, with only rare scattered positive cells in the surrounding interstitium. The distribution is compatible with a B-cell marker (such as CD20) highlighting a B-cell follicle; the specific antibody is not stated. The aggregate is well circumscribed and not paratrabecular. Findings support a B-cell-rich lymphoid follicle; light-chain, BCL2 and CD10 studies are needed to exclude a B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: FL follicles are paratrabecular and co-express BCL2 with CD10/BCL6 in follicle center cells, whereas reactive germinal centers are BCL2-negative.
MZL shows light-chain-restricted B cells, often with intrasinusoidal distribution, which a single CD20 stain cannot distinguish from reactive B cells.
A T-cell-predominant or mast cell lesion would be largely negative for a B-cell marker, unlike this diffusely positive aggregate.

1048.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中散在三顆淋巴球，體積較一般小淋巴球大、淡藍細胞質較多，其中一顆邊緣被紅血球擠壓呈扇貝狀，符合傳染性單核球增多症的反應性淋巴球。
features: Three lymphocytes larger than typical small lymphocytes
Moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm, with scalloping around adjacent red cells in one cell
Round to oval nuclei with condensed chromatin; no nucleoli seen at this magnification
Normocytic, normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
Platelets present and appear adequate
1048.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-medium power shows several enlarged lymphocytes with increased pale blue cytoplasm, one of which indents around adjacent red cells. Nuclei are round to oval without evident nucleoli. Red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with reactive lymphocytes, as seen in infectious mononucleosis; the degree of lymphocytosis cannot be judged from a single field.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are small, monotonous with scant cytoplasm and clumped chromatin, often with smudge cells, rather than large cells with abundant scalloped cytoplasm.
Blasts show fine chromatin, nucleoli and high N:C ratio, features absent here.
Monocytes have folded nuclei and grey vacuolated cytoplasm rather than clear blue cytoplasm hugging red cells.

4184.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片低倍下，在混合的造血細胞中散在許多細胞質含粗大深紫色顆粒的細胞，部分呈梭形或不規則，符合增加的肥大細胞；需在高倍確認核形並以 CD25/CD2 及 KIT D816V 支持系統性肥大細胞增生症。
features: Mixed hematopoietic cells in a particle-poor aspirate with fat spaces
Scattered cells with dense dark purple cytoplasmic granules consistent with mast cells
Some granulated cells spindled or irregular in outline
Admixed erythroid precursors, granulocytes and lymphocytes
Low magnification limits detailed nuclear assessment
4184.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low magnification shows mixed trilineage hematopoietic cells with numerous scattered cells containing coarse dark purple metachromatic granules, several with spindled or irregular contours, consistent with increased mast cells. Nuclear detail is limited at this power. Findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by systemic mastocytosis; atypical morphology in more than 25 percent of mast cells, CD25/CD2 expression and KIT D816V testing support the diagnosis.

ddx.dx: Basophilia in CML or other MPN
ddx.vs: Basophils have lobated nuclei obscured by granules and are smaller and round, not spindled.
Reactive mast cells are round, well granulated and scattered, lacking spindled morphology and CD25 expression.
Eosinophils have bilobed nuclei and orange-red refractile granules rather than purple metachromatic granules.

4056.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中一片淡染、以梭形細胞為主的病灶旁，有棕色膜狀染色的小圓細胞成群聚集與散在分布，而病灶內梭形細胞本身不著色；此染色標記未標示，無法單憑此圖確認陽性細胞是否為肥大細胞，需配合 tryptase/CD117/CD25 判讀。
features: Clusters and scattered single small round cells with strong membranous brown staining
Densest positive cluster at the edge of a pale spindle-cell-rich lesion
Spindled cells within the lesion are negative
Surrounding cellular marrow with fat spaces; bone trabecula at top
Cytologic detail of positive cells limited at this magnification
4056.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (DAB; marker not specified) on a bone marrow biopsy shows a cluster and scattered individual small round cells with strong membranous positivity at the periphery of a pale, spindle-cell-rich lesion; the spindle cells within the lesion are negative. Because the marker is not stated and the positive cells are round rather than spindled, this stain may highlight an accompanying lymphoid component of a mastocytosis lesion rather than the mast cells themselves. Interpretation for systemic mastocytosis requires correlation with tryptase, CD117 and CD25 stains.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with associated lymphoid aggregate
ddx.vs: SM lesions often contain a central lymphoid aggregate rimmed by spindled tryptase+/CD25+ mast cells, and the lymphocytes stain with CD3/CD20 only.
Reactive aggregates lack surrounding spindled tryptase-positive mast cells and fibrosis.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by low-grade B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma forms monotonous CD20+ nodules with light-chain restriction and lacks a mast cell component.

3928.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見異型巨核細胞成群聚集、細胞核深染不規則，伴隨擴張充血的竇狀血管與出血，右側骨小樑增厚，是骨髓纖維化合併骨硬化的中倍影像。
features: Clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular, cloud-like nuclei
Dilated, congested sinusoids with extravasated red cells
Intrasinusoidal hematopoietic cells
Fibrotic, loosely arranged stroma between cellular areas
Thickened bony trabecula at the right edge
Reduced granulocytic and erythroid precursors
3928.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, irregularly lobated, cloud-like nuclei set in a loose fibrotic stroma. Sinusoids are dilated and congested, with extravasated red cells and intrasinusoidal hematopoietic cells, and an adjacent bony trabecula appears thickened. Normal granulocytic and erythroid precursors are reduced. Findings are consistent with a fibrotic-stage myeloproliferative neoplasm with osteosclerosis, most suggestive of primary myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei, loosely scattered, without significant fibrosis or sinusoidal dilation.
MDS-F features small hypolobated megakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia rather than bulbous hyperchromatic megakaryocyte clusters.
APMF has increased CD34-positive blasts (≥20%) with small dysplastic megakaryocytes and an acute clinical course.

3864.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆帶狀嗜中性球（band neutrophil）的細胞質內（箭頭）可見數顆帶透明暈的小型卵圓形酵母菌與空泡化，是瀰漫性組織漿菌病在血液中的表現；本圖為血液抹片而非骨髓肉芽腫。
features: Band neutrophil with vacuolated cytoplasm containing several small oval organisms with clear halos (arrow)
Organisms approximately 2–4 µm with eccentric basophilic chromatin
Adjacent monocyte with vacuolated grey-blue cytoplasm
Dense dark overlying body at the cell junction, likely a platelet clump or pyknotic cell
Nearby neutrophil with toxic granulation
Background red cells with echinocytic changes
3864.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a band neutrophil with vacuolated cytoplasm containing several small, oval yeast-like organisms with clear halos (arrow), adjacent to a vacuolated monocyte and a dense dark overlying body. Another neutrophil shows toxic granulation, and red cells are crenated. Although titled as a marrow granuloma case, this image is a blood smear. Findings are consistent with intracellular Histoplasma capsulatum in circulating neutrophils, indicating disseminated histoplasmosis with a high organism burden.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes show a nucleus plus a bar-shaped kinetoplast and are GMS negative, unlike Histoplasma yeasts.

ddx.dx: Cytoplasmic vacuolization from sepsis or storage artifact
ddx.vs: Simple vacuoles are empty clear spaces, whereas Histoplasma shows a basophilic body within the halo.
Morulae are mulberry-like clusters of tiny basophilic dots without individual halos, rather than discrete oval yeasts.
Talaromyces yeasts are similar in size but some are elongated with a central transverse septum from fission, with Southeast Asian exposure.

3736.recognize_zh: 鐵染色（Prussian blue）下，一顆被紅色核染劑染成粉紅的紅血球母細胞核，周圍環繞一圈藍綠色的鐵顆粒、排列在核的外圍，形成環狀，這就是環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）；影像失焦、解析度有限。
features: Single erythroid precursor nucleus stained pink-red by the counterstain
Blue siderotic granules arranged around the nuclear perimeter in a ring-like distribution
Granules encircle most of the nuclear circumference
Few scattered free iron granules in the adjacent background
Image is out of focus, limiting granule counting and assessment of cytoplasmic outline
3736.describe_en: Iron-stained bone marrow aspirate smear (Prussian blue with a red nuclear counterstain) shows an erythroid precursor with multiple blue siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear ring encircling most of the nucleus. The image is blurred, so the exact number of granules and the proportion of the circumference involved cannot be precisely assessed. Findings are consistent with a ring sideroblast (conventionally at least 5 granules covering at least one third of the nuclear circumference).

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts contain only 1–4 small scattered cytoplasmic granules that are not arranged around the nucleus.
Storage iron lies in macrophages as coarse clumps or diffuse blue cytoplasm and is not organized as a perinuclear ring within an erythroblast.
Pappenheimer bodies are small iron granules in anucleate red cells, without a surrounding nucleus.

3608.recognize_zh: 高倍下兩顆分葉核嗜中性球，細胞核分成 3 葉、以細絲相連，染色質粗塊狀，細胞質淡粉紅並佈滿均勻細小的淡紫色特殊顆粒，沒有空泡或杜勒小體，是正常成熟嗜中性球。
features: Two cells about 1.5–2 times the diameter of an RBC
Nuclei segmented into 3 lobes joined by thin chromatin strands
Coarsely clumped chromatin; no nucleoli
Abundant pale pink cytoplasm with fine, evenly dispersed lilac-pink specific granules
No toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or vacuoles
Adjacent platelets and normal red cells
3608.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows two mature segmented neutrophils. Each nucleus has three lobes joined by thin filaments with coarse condensed chromatin and no nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant and pale with fine, evenly distributed specific granules, without toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or vacuolization. Adjacent platelets and red cells are unremarkable. Findings represent normal mature neutrophil morphology.

ddx.vs: A band has a continuous U- or S-shaped nucleus without filamentous constrictions between lobes.
Hypersegmented neutrophils have six or more lobes, as in megaloblastic anemia, compared with three here.
Toxic granulation shows coarse dark blue-black granules, often with Döhle bodies and vacuoles, unlike these fine lilac granules.

3480.recognize_zh: 大腸鏡影像可見一顆表面光滑、粉紅色、黏膜完整且有細小血管紋路的圓形隆起性息肉（polypoid lesion）；外觀屬黏膜下隆起型，本身無法判定為淋巴瘤，需靠切片確診。
features: Endoscopic view of colon (hepatic flexure) with a solitary, smooth, round polypoid lesion
Intact, glistening overlying mucosa with fine surface vascular pattern
No ulceration, surface erosion or irregular pit pattern visible
Surrounding haustral folds unremarkable with residual stool fluid
3480.describe_en: Colonoscopic image shows a solitary, well-circumscribed, smooth, pink polypoid lesion at the hepatic flexure. The overlying mucosa appears intact without ulceration or an irregular surface pattern, suggesting a subepithelial or lymphoid-rich mass rather than an adenoma. The endoscopic appearance is nonspecific and cannot establish lymphoma. Histologic sampling is required; in this case the lesion proved to be follicular lymphoma, grade 1.

ddx.vs: Adenomas have a lobulated, reddish surface with an altered pit/glandular pattern, whereas this lesion has smooth normal-appearing mucosa over a submucosal bulge.
Lipomas are yellowish, soft and show the cushion (pillow) sign on probing, unlike this pink lesion; histology or EUS separates them.
Endoscopy cannot separate these; histology showing polarized reactive germinal centers and BCL2-negative follicles excludes lymphoma.
Colonic NETs are typically small yellowish submucosal nodules; distinction relies on biopsy with chromogranin/synaptophysin.

3352.recognize_zh: 中倍率免疫染色：許多大型腫瘤細胞呈細胞膜環狀陽性，同時背景中大量小淋巴球也強陽性，代表這是一個腫瘤細胞與反應性小淋巴球共同表現的淋巴球標記（未標示抗體，可能為 T 細胞或白血球共同標記），用來佐證 ALCL 的淋巴球來源。
features: Diffuse lymphoid infiltrate at intermediate magnification
Large cells with membranous ring-like brown staining and clear cytoplasm
Numerous small lymphocytes with strong dense membranous and cytoplasmic staining
A proportion of large cells are weak or negative
Negative stromal and endothelial nuclei in the background
3352.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node at intermediate power shows a diffuse infiltrate of large atypical cells admixed with small lymphocytes. Many large cells show membranous ring-like positivity, while numerous background small lymphocytes are strongly positive and some large cells are weak or negative. The antibody is not labeled; the pattern indicates a lymphoid-lineage (T-cell or leukocyte) marker shared by tumor cells and reactive small lymphocytes. This supports a hematolymphoid origin of the large cells, consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma in context, but lineage assignment requires the full panel, because ALCL often loses pan-T-cell antigens such as CD3.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are usually negative for CD45 and T-cell markers and are surrounded by positive rosetting T cells rather than forming sheets.
DLBCL large cells stain for B-cell markers (CD20, PAX5) and are negative for T-cell antigens stained in small reactive cells.
Non-hematopoietic tumors are negative for leukocyte and T-cell markers and express cytokeratin or S100/SOX10.

3224.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中兩顆組織球的細胞質內塞滿數十顆完整的橘紅色紅血球，其中一顆還吞入一個有核細胞，周圍是富含紅血球前驅細胞的骨髓，符合噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Two histiocytes distended by numerous intact, orange-red erythrocytes
One histiocyte also contains an engulfed nucleated cell with a dense round nucleus
Histiocyte nuclei inconspicuous, compressed by ingested material
Background cellular marrow with erythroid precursors, occasional larger mononuclear cells and a fat space
Bright eosin staining of red cells (fixative-related)
3224.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows histiocytes containing abundant phagocytosed intact erythrocytes, with one histiocyte also containing a nucleated cell. The surrounding marrow is cellular with numerous erythroid precursors and scattered larger mononuclear cells. No granulomas or overt lymphoma infiltrate is seen in this field. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis; in the setting of acute EBV infection, correlation with HLH diagnostic criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, soluble CD25) is required, as histologic hemophagocytosis alone is neither sensitive nor specific.

ddx.vs: Reactive hemophagocytosis is morphologically identical and is separated from HLH only by clinical and laboratory criteria.
Erythroblastic islands consist of a central macrophage surrounded by, not filled with, maturing nucleated erythroid precursors.
Siderophages contain golden-brown refractile granules that are Prussian blue positive rather than intact round erythrocytes.
Lymphoma-associated cases show an accompanying atypical lymphoid infiltrate highlighted by CD3/CD56/EBER staining.

3096.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個巨大多核細胞，六、七個分開的圓形至橢圓形細胞核，各自帶有小核仁，散布在大量淡藍灰色、細顆粒狀的細胞質中，這是蝕骨細胞（osteoclast）而非核葉相連的巨核細胞。
features: Very large multinucleated cell, many times the diameter of surrounding cells
Multiple (about 6-7) separate, round to oval nuclei of similar size, not overlapping or lobulated
Nuclei with finely granular chromatin and small single nucleoli
Abundant, irregularly shaped, pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granularity and frayed edges
Background of normal marrow elements: erythroid precursors, granulocytes, and lymphocytes
3096.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large multinucleated cell with abundant, finely granular, pale blue-gray cytoplasm and irregular, frayed borders. It contains multiple discrete round to oval nuclei of uniform size, each with fine chromatin and a small nucleolus, without nuclear lobation or overlap. Surrounding hematopoietic cells, including erythroid precursors and granulocytes, appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with an osteoclast, a normal marrow constituent more often seen in aspirates from children or states of increased bone remodeling.

ddx.vs: A megakaryocyte has a single multilobated, interconnected nucleus with dense chromatin and pink granular cytoplasm, whereas the osteoclast has multiple separate, uniform nuclei with nucleoli.
Tumor clusters show cohesive, pleomorphic, overlapping nuclei with distinct cell borders, whereas the osteoclast has uniform bland nuclei in one shared cytoplasm.
Osteoblasts are mononuclear with an eccentric nucleus and a paranuclear hof, often in small clusters, unlike the multinucleated osteoclast.
Histiocytic giant cells arise in granulomas with epithelioid histiocytes and inflammation, while an isolated osteoclast in an otherwise normal aspirate lacks that setting.

2968.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片整個視野只有一顆小淋巴球，看不到嗜中性球，血小板也很少，並有散在的棘狀紅血球（echinocytes）；呈現血球減少的樣貌，但本身不能診斷噬血症候群。
features: Only a single small mature lymphocyte in the field; no neutrophils seen
Platelets markedly sparse
Red cells largely normocytic with scattered crenated/echinocytic forms
No blasts, schistocytes or nucleated red cells identified
2968.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells that are largely normocytic with scattered crenated forms (echinocytes), and very few platelets. A single small mature lymphocyte is the only leukocyte in the field, and no neutrophils are identified. No blasts or schistocytes are seen. Findings suggest leukopenia and thrombocytopenia, consistent with the cytopenias of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, although the peripheral smear itself is nonspecific.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows a hypocellular marrow without histiocytic activation, fever, splenomegaly or hyperferritinemia.
Leukemia usually shows circulating blasts and a marrow blast excess.
Crenated cells from delayed smear preparation are artifactual and do not indicate disease.

2520.recognize_zh: 肝臟切片（H&E）中，肝細胞索之間的竇狀隙（sinusoid）塞滿核偏位的漿細胞樣細胞，左側匯管區亦有密集同類細胞浸潤，符合漿細胞白血病的肝臟浸潤。
features: Liver parenchyma with hepatocyte plates separated by dilated sinusoids
Sinusoids filled with discohesive cells having round eccentric nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm (plasmacytoid)
Dense sheet-like infiltrate of similar cells in a portal/periportal area at left
Some cells with coarse clockface chromatin and perinuclear clearing
No granulomas or necrosis evident
2520.describe_en: Section of liver shows a diffuse sinusoidal infiltrate of discohesive cells with round eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, consistent with plasma cells, accompanied by a dense portal infiltrate of similar cells at the left. Hepatocyte plates are preserved without significant necrosis. The sinusoidal distribution reflects hematogenous spread of a circulating neoplasm. Findings are consistent with hepatic involvement by a plasma cell neoplasm, compatible with plasma cell leukemia in the appropriate context; CD138 and kappa/lambda immunostains or ISH are recommended to confirm clonality.

ddx.vs: Extramedullary hematopoiesis contains mixed erythroid precursors, megakaryocytes and granulocytes rather than a monotonous plasmacytoid population.

ddx.dx: Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma or leukemic lymphoma
ddx.vs: Sinusoidal lymphoma cells lack eccentric nuclei and hofs and are CD3 or CD20 positive and CD138 negative.
Reactive infiltrates are mixed lymphocytes and polytypic plasma cells, mostly portal with interface activity, not diffuse monotypic sinusoidal filling.

2456.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞極多，幾乎全是顆粒球系各階段細胞（前骨髓細胞、骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀與分葉中性球），並可見深紫色顆粒的嗜鹼性球，原始細胞不多，這種「全階段顆粒球增生合併嗜鹼性球」是慢性期 CML 的典型骨髓。
features: Markedly hypercellular aspirate with granulocytic hyperplasia
Full spectrum of maturation: promyelocytes, myelocytes (predominant), metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Basophils with dark purple granules obscuring the nucleus
Eosinophil precursors with orange granules
Blasts not increased; erythroid precursors relatively decreased
2456.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly hypercellular with striking granulocytic hyperplasia showing orderly maturation from promyelocytes through myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, with a myelocyte predominance. Basophils and eosinophil precursors are readily identified. Blasts are not increased and erythroid precursors are relatively reduced. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, chronic phase; confirmation requires demonstration of t(9;22)/BCR-ABL1.

ddx.vs: Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation and Döhle bodies without basophilia or eosinophilia and are BCR-ABL1 negative.
CNL shows predominantly mature neutrophils with few immature forms and no basophilia, and carries CSF3R mutations.
Atypical CML shows prominent dysgranulopoiesis without basophilia and lacks BCR-ABL1.
Advanced phases show increased blasts (10–19% or >=20%) or basophils >=20%, which are not seen here.

2200.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液中白血球增加，多為核質比高、細胞質極少的單一型芽細胞，並有數個破碎的塗抹細胞（smudge cells），血小板稀少，提示急性白血病；Ph+ 需分子確認。
features: Increased circulating mononuclear blasts at low power
Blasts with high N:C ratio and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Several smudge cells (disrupted fragile blasts)
Few mature neutrophils; platelets markedly reduced
Red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis
2200.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low magnification shows numerous circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and scant basophilic cytoplasm, accompanied by several smudge cells. Mature neutrophils are sparse and platelets are markedly decreased. Red cells are largely normocytic without notable poikilocytosis. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification, and lineage and the Philadelphia chromosome require flow cytometry and cytogenetic/molecular testing. Findings are suggestive of acute leukemia, consistent with Ph+ acute lymphoblastic leukemia in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: CLL shows small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin plus smudge cells, rather than blasts with fine chromatin.
AML blasts may contain granules or Auer rods and are MPO positive; lineage requires flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in lymphoid blast phase
ddx.vs: Blast phase CML usually shows accompanying basophilia and left-shifted granulocytes, which are absent here.

2072.recognize_zh: 低倍胃切片中，表層仍保有胃腺體，但其下方的深部黏膜與黏膜下層被一條厚而致密的深藍色淋巴細胞帶佔滿，腺體被推擠變少，浸潤直達黏膜下脂肪上方，是胃 MALT 淋巴瘤的低倍表現。
features: Thick band-like dense basophilic lymphoid infiltrate expanding deep mucosa and submucosa
Superficial gastric glands preserved but separated and reduced in number, with focal gland loss
Infiltrate abuts submucosal fat and vessels at the base
Surface epithelium largely intact; no deep ulceration in this field
Lymphoepithelial lesions and cytology not assessable at this magnification
2072.describe_en: Low-power section of gastric wall shows a dense, band-like lymphoid infiltrate expanding the deep lamina propria and submucosa beneath the preserved superficial glandular mucosa. The infiltrate separates and partially replaces the gastric glands and extends down to the submucosal fat. Lymphoepithelial lesions and cytologic detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of gastric extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of MALT, requiring higher-power evaluation and immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD43, cytokeratin for lymphoepithelial lesions, light chains).

ddx.dx: Chronic H. pylori gastritis with lymphoid hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates are superficial and mixed with discrete follicles and plasma cells, lack destructive lymphoepithelial lesions and are polyclonal.
DLBCL shows sheets of large transformed B cells with high Ki-67 rather than small marginal zone cells.
MCL is composed of monotonous small cells expressing CD5 and cyclin D1.

1880.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向中性球兩個核葉之間的小型染色質突起／細絲連接處，形成像小結節或小鉤狀的附屬物，大小遠小於鼓槌體，屬於正常中性球的核附屬物變異。
features: Mature segmented neutrophil with four nuclear lobes
Small chromatin projection at the junction between two lobes (arrow)
Projection lacks the rounded head and slender stalk of a drumstick
Pale pink-lilac cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
Background red cells and occasional platelets unremarkable
1880.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with four nuclear lobes connected by chromatin filaments and pale cytoplasm containing fine neutrophilic granules. A small chromatin projection is present near the junction of two lobes (arrow), without the rounded head and thin stalk of a drumstick. No toxic granulation, vacuoles or Döhle bodies are seen. Findings represent a nuclear appendage in a normal neutrophil, a benign morphologic variant.

ddx.vs: Drumsticks are discrete ~1.5 µm round heads on a thin stalk projecting outward from a lobe, whereas this projection is small and irregular at a lobe junction.
These are other nonspecific appendage shapes of similar significance, distinguished only descriptively, and none carries pathologic meaning.
Apoptotic cells show dense, round, separated pyknotic nuclear fragments and condensed cytoplasm rather than a small tag on otherwise normal lobes.

1816.recognize_zh: 這顆雙葉的嗜中性球在兩個核葉交界處的細胞質內有一顆小圓形淡色包涵體，疑為桑椹體（morula）；位於嗜中性球內應歸為 Anaplasma phagocytophilum，但包涵體很小，需以 PCR 或血清學確認。
features: Neutrophil with bilobed nucleus and fine cytoplasmic granules
Small round cytoplasmic inclusion adjacent to the nuclear lobes, compatible with a morula (small, limited resolution)
Normocytic red cells with rouleaux-free monolayer and no intraerythrocytic parasites
Blue-staining irregular fragment (upper right) consistent with stain precipitate or debris
Small platelet at the lower edge of the field
1816.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a normocytic red cell population without intraerythrocytic parasites. A neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus contains a small round cytoplasmic inclusion near the nuclear lobes, compatible with a morula, although its small size limits confident identification. An irregular blue fragment in the field represents stain precipitate or debris. Findings are suggestive of granulocytic anaplasmosis (formerly human granulocytic ehrlichiosis) in the proper clinical context and should be confirmed by PCR or serology.

ddx.vs: Morulae reside in monocytes, not in neutrophils.
Döhle bodies are pale grey-blue peripheral patches and toxic vacuoles are empty, whereas a morula is a stippled basophilic cluster.
A platelet on top of a cell has a granular purple granulomere with pale hyalomere and sits outside the cell's focal plane.
Explains a bilobed nucleus but does not produce cytoplasmic inclusions.

1624.recognize_zh: 綠色對比染色背景中，棕色染色在一塊區域呈纖細、分枝狀的網狀樣式，周邊則有部分細胞呈環狀膜染色，其他區域陰性；屬正常淋巴組織的免疫染色分區表現，影像解析度與抗原未標示限制了判讀。
features: Brown reticular/dendritic staining pattern concentrated in one region (right center)
Peripheral cells with ring-like membranous staining (right and lower margins)
Largely negative areas elsewhere with green counterstain
Low magnification and soft focus limit cytologic assessment
Specific antigen not identified in the image
1624.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain with a green counterstain shows brown staining with a fine reticular, dendritic-like pattern in one region, and ring-like membranous staining of lymphoid cells at its periphery, while the remaining tissue is largely negative. The antigen is not specified and focus is soft, limiting interpretation; the pattern would fit a compartment-restricted marker within a normal follicle or its surrounding zone. Findings are consistent with normal lymphoid tissue compartmentalization.

ddx.dx: Expanded FDC meshwork (e.g., angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: AITL shows irregular CD21/CD23-positive FDC meshworks extending beyond follicles around HEVs, whereas the staining here is confined to a discrete region.

ddx.dx: Disrupted FDC meshwork in follicular lymphoma or NLPHL
ddx.vs: Neoplastic nodules show large expanded or fragmented meshworks throughout the node, which cannot be assessed in this single low-resolution field.

1432.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片兩格中細胞量豐富，箭頭標示多處異常細胞：分葉不足或雙葉核的顆粒球（pseudo-Pelger 樣）、核染色質異常團塊的細胞，以及紅系前驅細胞的異常，顯示不只一系出現發育異常。
features: Cellular aspirate with a mixture of erythroid precursors, maturing granulocytes and some larger immature cells
Arrows highlight hypolobated/bilobed granulocytes with clumped chromatin (pseudo-Pelger-like forms) and hypogranular cytoplasm
Arrowed cell with abnormal clumped, star-shaped nuclear chromatin (possible abnormal mitosis or karyorrhexis)
Erythroid precursors with some nuclear irregularity; megaloblastoid features cannot be confirmed at this resolution
Scattered larger cells with open chromatin (promyelocytes/myelocytes); no sheets of blasts
Resolution limits detailed grading of dysplasia in each arrowed cell
1432.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (two fields) shows a cellular specimen with erythroid precursors, maturing granulocytes and scattered larger immature myeloid cells. Several dysplastic cells are indicated by arrows, including hypolobated or bilobed granulocytes with clumped chromatin and pale cytoplasm (pseudo-Pelger-like), and a cell with an abnormal clumped star-shaped nuclear configuration suggestive of an abnormal mitotic figure or karyorrhexis. Blasts are not increased in these fields, although a formal differential count is required. Findings are consistent with the stated diagnosis of myelodysplastic syndrome with multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no dysplasia in other lineages.
Shows giant metamyelocytes, hypersegmented neutrophils and megaloblastic erythroid precursors that correct with B12/folate.
Requires 5-19% marrow blasts by aspirate differential count, which is not evident in these fields.
Morphologically similar, so prior cytotoxic therapy, drug history and cytogenetics are needed to separate them.

60568.recognize_zh: 中央一顆大細胞有兩個相鄰的空泡狀核，各帶明顯的嗜伊紅／深紫色大核仁（macronucleolus），周圍有空白收縮暈，背景是小淋巴球、組織球與嗜酸性球的混合發炎細胞，典型的 Reed-Sternberg 細胞。
features: Very large binucleate cell with two closely apposed, mirror-image oval nuclei
Vesicular, open chromatin with thick nuclear membranes
Prominent inclusion-like macronucleolus in the upper nucleus and a smaller central nucleolus in the lower nucleus
Abundant pale cytoplasm with a surrounding clear retraction space
Mixed inflammatory background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes/larger vesicular cells and an eosinophil at the right
60568.describe_en: Section of a lymphoid tissue (likely lymph node) at high power shows a very large binucleate cell with two apposed oval nuclei, vesicular chromatin, thick nuclear membranes and a prominent eosinophilic to purple macronucleolus, surrounded by abundant pale cytoplasm and a retraction space. The background is a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and occasional eosinophils. No sheets of large atypical cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a Reed-Sternberg cell and suggestive of classic Hodgkin lymphoma; confirmation by immunohistochemistry (CD30+, CD15+, PAX5 weak, CD45-) is recommended.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows sheets of cohesive hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei, CD30 strong but PAX5 negative, often ALK or T-cell antigen positive.
Immunoblasts are smaller mononuclear cells with a single central nucleolus, CD45+ and strong PAX5/CD20 or T-cell markers, lacking bilobed mirror-image nuclei.
LP cells have multilobated popcorn nuclei with small nucleoli and are CD20+, CD45+, CD30-/CD15-.

60504.recognize_zh: 細胞內滿是粗大、深紫黑色、大小不一的顆粒，重疊在核上使核型難以辨認，這是嗜鹼性球（basophil）最典型的特徵。
features: Granulocyte approximately 1.5 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Numerous coarse, dark purple-black cytoplasmic granules of variable size
Granules overlie and largely obscure the nucleus
Underlying nucleus appears segmented/lobated with condensed chromatin
Background normochromic red cells without significant abnormality
60504.describe_en: High-power peripheral blood smear shows a single granulocyte surrounded by normochromic red cells. The cell contains abundant coarse, dark purple-black granules of variable size that overlie and largely obscure a lobated nucleus with condensed chromatin. Findings are consistent with a mature basophil; persistent absolute basophilia should prompt evaluation for a myeloproliferative neoplasm such as chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Mast cells have a round, non-lobated central nucleus with densely packed, uniform granules and are CD117/tryptase positive, rarely circulating.
Eosinophil granules are uniform orange-red and do not obscure the bilobed nucleus.
Toxic granules are smaller and scattered in pale pink cytoplasm, leaving the segmented nucleus clearly visible.

60312.recognize_zh: 中央一顆幼紅血球的核圓、細胞質深藍色，並在細胞質內（尤其邊緣）布滿許多小而清楚的空泡（vacuoles），左上方另有一顆類似的空泡化細胞，符合空泡化的紅血球前驅細胞（vacuolated erythroid precursors）。
features: Early erythroid precursor with a round central nucleus and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Numerous small, discrete, punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles, concentrated at the periphery of the cell
A second vacuolated precursor at the upper left of the field
Cellular marrow aspirate with many erythroid and granulocytic precursors at various stages
Some precursors show coarse chromatin and nuclear irregularity; significance cannot be judged from one field
60312.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field containing erythroid and granulocytic precursors at various stages of maturation. An early erythroid precursor in the center has a round nucleus and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous small, discrete vacuoles, and a similarly vacuolated precursor is present at the upper left. Findings are consistent with vacuolated erythroid precursors; this change is nonspecific and may be seen with alcohol toxicity, copper deficiency or zinc excess, chloramphenicol or linezolid therapy, and in myelodysplastic neoplasms or acute erythroid leukemia, requiring clinical and laboratory correlation.

ddx.vs: Vacuoles look identical, so low serum copper and ceruloplasmin (often with neutropenia and ring sideroblasts) rather than morphology identify this cause.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of vacuolated proerythroblasts making up at least 80% of marrow cells, whereas this field contains mixed maturing lineages.
Burkitt cells also have basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but have multiple nucleoli, are B-cell by immunophenotype and lack erythroid maturation.
Toxic vacuolation is morphologically indistinguishable and reverses on withdrawal of the agent, so exposure history is the discriminator.

88.recognize_zh: 淋巴結內可見比周圍反應性濾泡大好幾倍的膨大濾泡，生發中心被小型套區淋巴球滲入而呈斑駁、界線模糊；IgD 染色顯示 IgD 陽性套區細胞大量侵入濾泡內，只剩零碎的 IgD 陰性生發中心殘島，符合生發中心進行性轉化（PTGC）。
features: Markedly enlarged, expansile follicles several times the size of adjacent reactive secondary follicles
Germinal centers broken up and blurred by infiltrating small mantle-zone lymphocytes, giving a mottled appearance
Background of preserved nodal architecture with ordinary reactive follicles and interfollicular vessels
IgD highlights small mantle-type B cells permeating the follicle, leaving small IgD-negative germinal center remnants
High power: IgD-positive small lymphocytes stream into the follicle among IgD-negative centroblast-like cells; no clusters of atypical large cells evident
88.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show preserved overall architecture with numerous reactive secondary follicles. Several follicles are markedly enlarged and expansile, with germinal centers that are disrupted and blurred by ingrowth of small mantle-zone lymphocytes, imparting a mottled appearance. An IgD stain highlights mantle-zone B cells extensively infiltrating these large follicles, leaving only fragmented IgD-negative germinal center remnants. No sheets of atypical large cells are identified on these images. Findings are consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers; correlation with CD20, CD3/PD-1 and OCT-2 staining is advised to exclude nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: NLPHL shows effacement by many large nodules containing scattered LP (popcorn) cells with CD20+/OCT-2 strong/BCL6+ expression rimmed by PD-1+ T cells, whereas PTGC is a minority of enlarged follicles in an otherwise reactive node without LP cells.
Follicular lymphoma has back-to-back monotonous follicles with attenuated mantles and BCL2-positive germinal center cells, not IgD-positive mantle cells infiltrating a few large follicles.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone or nodular pattern
ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma is a monotonous cyclin D1+/SOX11+ population that effaces the node, whereas the infiltrating IgD+ mantle cells in PTGC are polyclonal and cyclin D1-negative.
Lymphocyte-rich cHL contains CD30+/CD15+, PAX5-dim Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells within expanded mantle zones, which are absent in PTGC.

24.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中的顆粒球核只有兩葉，呈對稱的圓形或啞鈴狀「夾鼻眼鏡（pince-nez）」外觀，染色質粗糙緊密，細胞質顆粒正常、沒有發育不良的其他表現；另見單一圓核的顆粒球。在家族史背景下符合 Pelger–Huët anomaly。
features: Mature-sized granulocytes with bilobed nuclei forming symmetric round lobes (pince-nez/spectacle configuration)
Markedly coarse, condensed chromatin indicating nuclear maturity despite hyposegmentation
Normal cytoplasmic granulation without hypogranularity or vacuolation
One granulocyte with a single round, non-segmented nucleus (Stodtmeister-type form; low magnification, cell type uncertain)
Background red cells and platelets unremarkable; a smudged/disrupted leukocyte is present
24.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis and adequate, normal-appearing platelets. Granulocytes display nuclear hyposegmentation, with bilobed nuclei composed of two symmetric, rounded lobes in a pince-nez configuration, and a granulocyte with a single round nucleus is also seen at low power. The chromatin is coarse and clumped, and cytoplasmic granulation is normal, without dysgranulopoiesis. In an otherwise healthy infant with affected family members, the findings are consistent with Pelger–Huët anomaly.

ddx.vs: Acquired pseudo-Pelger cells typically affect only a subset of neutrophils and are accompanied by hypogranular cytoplasm, cytopenias and other dysplasia, whereas inherited PHA involves nearly all neutrophils with normal granulation and no cytopenias.

ddx.dx: Drug-induced pseudo-Pelger change (e.g., mycophenolate, colchicine, taxanes, valproate)
ddx.vs: Drug effect is transient and linked to exposure, while PHA is lifelong and familial, which requires history and family smears rather than morphology alone.
Bands have a C- or U-shaped unsegmented nucleus with less condensed chromatin, whereas Pelger cells have round, dense, fully mature lobes.
SGD also shows bilobed nuclei but with markedly reduced secondary granules and recurrent infections, unlike the normally granulated cells here.
